Shift:

Monday through Friday, 8:00AM - 5:00PM

Are you ready to work making the world a safer, healthier place? Join our mission to continuously move science forward; to innovate and advance all aspects of our business to improve the health and safety of our communities and lives.

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Quality Assurance Consultants to support food, dietary supplement, ingredient, packaging, and consumer product manufacturers in achieving and maintaining compliance with Food Safety and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements. The ideal candidate has a strong background in food quality systems, regulatory compliance, supplier qualification, auditing, and food safety program development.

This role provides the opportunity to support clients across the food and consumer products industries, helping organizations strengthen quality systems, prepare for regulatory inspections, implement food safety programs, and maintain compliance with applicable FDA and industry requirements.

NOTE:This is an evergreen posting for future positions within our team.  If you would like to be considered during the next round of hirings and have the qualifications, please apply.

NOTE: This is a PRN role with expected hours to be between 15-20 hours per week

Compensation:$62.500 - 76.50 per hour

Responsibilities

  • Conduct assessments and audits of food manufacturing, packaging, warehousing, distribution, and ingredient supplier operations.
  • Evaluate compliance with FDA food regulations, food GMP requirements, and industry food safety standards.
  • Perform gap assessments against applicable regulations and standards, including:
    • 21 CFR Part 117 (Preventive Controls for Human Food)
    • 21 CFR Part 111 (Dietary Supplements), as applicable
    • FSMA requirements
    • HACCP principles
    • GFSI-recognized standards (SQF, BRCGS, FSSC 22000, IFS)
  • Develop and improve Quality Management Systems (QMS) and Food Safety Management Systems (FSMS).
  • Review and author SOPs, quality procedures, food safety plans, hazard analyses, and preventive control programs.
  • Support clients during FDA inspections, customer audits, certification audits, and regulatory responses.
  • Investigate quality events, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, and food safety incidents.
  • Review and assess CAPAs for adequacy, effectiveness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Support supplier qualification, vendor monitoring, and supplier auditing programs.
  • Provide training and coaching on GMPs, food safety requirements, HACCP, sanitation, documentation practices, and inspection readiness.
  • Prepare clear, concise reports, recommendations, and client deliverables.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evolving food safety regulations and industry best practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, Quality Assurance, or a related discipline.
  • 15+ years of Quality Assurance, Food Safety, or Regulatory Compliance experience within food, beverage, dietary supplement, ingredient, or consumer product manufacturing.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • FDA Food Regulations
    • FSMA
    • 21 CFR Part 117
    • HACCP Principles
    • GMP Requirements
    • Food Safety Management Systems
  • Experience conducting internal, supplier, contract manufacturer, and third-party audits.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining GFSI-recognized programs (SQF, BRCGS, FSSC 22000, or equivalent).
  • Strong understanding of risk assessment, root cause analysis, CAPA development, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Proven experience supporting regulatory inspections and certification audits.
  • Excellent technical writing, communication, and client-facing skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
  • HACCP or PCQI certification preferred.
  • Lead Auditor certification (SQF, BRCGS, ISO 22000, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel as required (domestic U.S. and occasional international travel).

Preferred Consulting Experience

  • Food Safety Plan development and implementation
  • FDA inspection readiness assessments
  • Food facility registration and compliance programs
  • Supplier qualification and auditing
  • Mock FDA inspections
  • Sanitation program evaluations
  • Environmental monitoring programs
  • Allergen control programs
  • Quality Management System implementation
  • Training and coaching of QA and production personnel

raw.title: Principal Software Engineer, Tech Lead - Platform
raw.excerpt: About Cardlytics Founded in 2008, Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is the industry-leading purchase intelligence and incentives platform.
raw.description:
About Cardlytics
Founded in 2008, Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is the industry-leading purchase intelligence and incentives platform. We make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone by helping businesses attract, understand, and incentivize consumers through our partners' digital reward programs. Join us on our mission to make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone!

About the Team

At Cardlytics, our goal is to streamline data consumption across the entire organization. We understand that accessible, reliable data underpins informed decision-making and innovative problem-solving. By partnering closely with product and engineering teams, we tailor our solutions to fit their specific workflow needs and make strategic investments in our platform to ensure swift access to data. Our approach is designed to simplify the way teams interact with data, to accelerate time-to-insight to enable Cardlytics teams to harness the full potential of their data for impactful outcomes, and to make deliberate technology choices that keep our data infrastructure cost-effective.

About the Position

Cardlytics is seeking a Principal Software Engineer, Tech Lead - Platform to join the team, reporting to the VP of Engineering, Cloud & Data Infrastructure.

We are looking for an experienced technical leader to own and evolve our data compute environment end-to-end on AWS, including defining the next-generation platform direction. In this role, you will make architectural, design, and operational decisions that shape how analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders interact with data at Cardlytics. As data consumption increasingly shifts toward AI and agentic applications, you will also shape the platform's evolution into an AI-ready foundation — spanning the semantic layer, feature store, and data ontology that these systems depend on. You will combine deep expertise in industry-leading data platforms with the ability to provide technical leadership, define platform standards, and act as the primary technical partner for diverse user groups across the organization.

You will:

  • Architecture and design: Design and evolve the Cardlytics next-generation architecture; establish reference architectures and standards for batch, streaming, ML, and AI/agentic workloads.

  • AI-ready data platform: Build out the semantic layer, feature store, and data ontology that make Cardlytics data consumable by AI/agentic applications; enable governed, self-service access for both human and machine (LLM/agent) consumers.

  • User enablement: Serve as the primary technical partner for analysts, engineers, and business users; develop self-service guides, onboarding materials, and best-practice documentation to reduce friction across all user groups.

  • Technical leadership: Set technical direction for the platform and mentor engineers across the data and platform teams; drive engineering excellence and best practices, and manage the vendor relationship.

  • Performance and reliability: Define monitoring standards and SLAs, lead performance tuning for Spark jobs, open table formats (e.g. Delta, Hudi), and SQL query engines; own incident response and root-cause analysis.

  • Governance and security: Drive adoption of a unified governance layer (e.g., Databricks Unity Catalog) for centralized RBAC, column-level security, data lineage, and metadata management; implement and maintain security best practices including encryption and audit logging.

  • Platform standards and governance: Define the operating model and guardrails for the managed lakehouse platforms (including Databricks on AWS) — compute policies, access model, catalog structure, and cost governance — with day-to-day administration executed by the platform and domain teams working within those standards.

  • Infrastructure as code: Own the CI/CD strategy for lakehouse and data platform deployments (Terraform, GitHub Actions, and platform-native packaging such as Asset Bundles); enforce DevOps practices across engineering teams.

You have:

  • 7+ years of experience in data engineering or data platform roles, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or architecture capacity.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with the leading industry platforms, frameworks, and tools: Databricks, AWS EMR or similar, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Spark (PySpark), and SQL; with a solid understanding of compute/cluster management on AWS.

  • Proven experience designing and delivering Lakehouse architectures and large-scale ELT/ETL pipelines in production environments.

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Terraform.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting diverse stakeholder groups including analysts, engineers (including ML engineers), and non-technical business users.

  • Strong understanding of data governance, data modeling, and cloud security best practices.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing or operating a semantic layer, feature store, or data ontology / knowledge graph in a production environment.

  • Familiarity with managing data for ML systems and AI/agentic applications, such as training pipelines or inference for LLM-powered and agentic tools.

Technical Environment

We primarily use macOS and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides). While our preferred platform is macOS, we support both macOS and Windows. Familiarity with or willingness to work within this environment is required.

Core Values

Our shared values are the driving force behind everything we do. Across all roles, we are looking for teammates who embody these values:

  • Customer and partner first

  • Act with urgency and focus

  • Integrity with our partners and data

  • Accountability even when challenged

  • Empowerment over hierarchy

  • Growth over comfort

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible paid time off plus company holidays

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance begins on your first day

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plan also includes a student loan debt repayment option

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Educational assistance for continuing education

  • Lifestyle Spending Account for physical, emotional, and financial wellness (like gym memberships, home down payments, art classes, park passes, and more!)

  • Complimentary Calm app subscriptions to support employee mental health and wellbeing

As an equal opportunity employer, Cardlytics is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our people bring our products and organization to life, and every unique perspective makes us better. If you can do the job and you’re excited about growing with us as we scale our best-in-class advertising platform, we’d love to hear from you. If you need accommodation in the recruiting process due to a disability, please email or inform your recruiter.

Role Details

Job Title: Crop Insurance Adjuster

Location: Remote-CA

Reports To: Joe Kemph
Employment Type: Full Time
Job Requisition ID: 2026-710

Requisition Begin Date: 7/17/2026

Role Overview:

ProAg has an exciting opportunity for a Crop Adjuster to join our team in the Sacramento Valley area. Imagine joining a team that’s part of an organization that shares your passion for American Agriculture. A team that understands the challenges ag producers face and the disproportionate financial risks they shoulder. How do you know this team has that passion and understanding? Because many of us at ProAg still farm and ranch ourselves or were raised on the farm or ranch. It’s in our blood.

As a ProAg Crop Adjuster, you will make first contact with our policy holder on the farm or ranch that has just experienced a loss. You will work with our customer to complete field inspections, read maps and aerial photos, measure fields and storage bins, collecting production records of farm commodities, all the while assessing damage or loss. You’ll stick with each claim for each grower until the work is done and the claim is settled.

Reporting to the Area Claims Supervisor, you will work regularly in the field on the farms, climbing grain bins, walking over rough terrain for long distances, etc. You will apply your good judgment, common sense and understanding of ProAg's adjusting guidelines and policy provisions for a variety of Multi-Peril Crop Insurance, Crop Hail, and Named Peril policies.

In this position, you will work from home and cover a territory of the Sacramento Valley. This position will require travel of up to 75%, occasionally even beyond your assigned territory.

In this Exciting Opportunity, You Will:

  • Perform fact-finding to determine cause(s) and percentage of loss, exercising your best independent judgment in the handling of claims. Escalate any issues or problems that you can’t resolve to the Area Claims Supervisor.
    • Convey regulations and interpretation of procedure to claimants, agents, and industry people on claim situations.
    • Effectively communicate our position on developing industry topics such as new specialty crops or expanding coverage programs.
    • Continuously expand your knowledge of RMA rules and regulations and ProAg procedures for applying all MPCI, Crop Hail, and Federal Crop Insurance regulations.

What You Bring:

• High school diploma

  • Crop insurance experience in claims or compliance or any ag-related experience and background
    • Analytical skills and attention to detail
    • Basic computer and internet applications
    • Communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills
    • Reliable means of transportation and the willingness to travel
    • Completion of your Claim Adjuster Proficiency Program (CAPP) certification and/or any applicable licenses required by State agencies preferred.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package
    • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities
    • Opportunities for growth and career advancement
    • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment

• Basic life and disability insurance

• 401(k) plan with 6% company match

  • 20 days of PTO, three floating holidays, approximately 10 paid holidays, and volunteer time off
    • Paid parental leave
    • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription
    • Student loan matching program
    • Employee discount program
    • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

What We Represent:

A career with purpose. Our crop insurance professionals work each day to bring peace of mind and protection to American farmers and ranchers. Join a team who truly cares.
• Part of something bigger: We offer a career with purpose as you support the farmers and ranchers who create food, fuel, and fiber for the world.
• Personal connections: We are built on strong relationships and appreciation of your individuality.
• A team who cares: We look out for each other personally and professionally because we care about each other.
• Innovators by trade: We’re committed to a brighter tomorrow for our team members and agriculture.
• The best of both worlds: We combine personal connections with powerful resources, thanks to our culture and the backing of Tokio Marine HCC.

The Company:

ProAg, a member of the Tokio Marine HCC group of companies, is positioned as a financially strong and well-capitalized insurer with an AM Best rating of A++. With 100 years of service to our agents & insureds, we stand committed to continuing the principles that ProAg was founded on: Integrity, Loyalty, and Customer Service. Tokio Marine HCC is a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and other exciting locations. With the strength and stability that comes from being a member of the Tokio Marine Group, and more than fifty years of growth, profitability, and stability, we offer important insurance products that most people don’t even know exist. Every policy we write is special, enabling our clients to do amazing

things.

The pay range is the range THMCC, in good faith, believes is the range of compensation for this role at the time of this posting. The hired applicant will be offered pay within the entire range based on the candidate’s geographic location, qualifications, work experience, education, and/or skill level. The Company is fully committed to ensuring equal pay opportunities for equal work regardless of color, race, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, age, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local pay equity laws.

Disclaimer:

Where the hiring and employment of individuals is not restricted by the foregoing, the Company will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history in compliance with applicable law such as the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the San Diego Fair Chance Ordinance, and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.]

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.

Job Title: Financial Analyst - Retail

Location: US (Remote)


Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin


The Role

As a Finance Analyst II – Retail, you’ll support financial planning, reporting, and analysis for the North America commercial business. You’ll partner with finance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver accurate reporting, meaningful insights, and analysis that evaluate business performance and operational effectiveness. You’ll also contribute to process improvements and basic automation initiatives to enhance efficiency, data accuracy, and business decision-making.


We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.


Your Impact

  • Support quarterly forecast and annual budget processes by updating models, gathering and validating inputs, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining supporting assumptions and documentation
  • Review submissions for accuracy and completeness, identify potential risks or inconsistencies, and track performance against budget and forecast through variance analysis
  • Prepare summary reports and analysis that clearly communicate key drivers, underlying data, and variances to finance leadership and support decision-making
  • Prepare recurring financial and management reports
  • Perform variance analysis versus budget and forecast, identifying key drivers and trends
  • Assist in maintaining and enhancing financial models used for performance evaluation and reporting
  • Support ad hoc financial analysis and reporting requests for finance leadership and cross-functional partners
  • Gather, analyze, and organize data to support business decisions and initiatives
  • Identify data gaps or inconsistencies and escalate findings appropriately
  • Continually monitor and evaluate processes and recurring deliverables to identify and reduce inefficiencies
  • Assist with basic automation and process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort
  • Create and maintain documentation for recurring reports, models, and processes in accordance with established standards
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close activities, including preparation of reporting materials and variance explanations
  • Partner with Accounting and Finance teams to support accurate and timely close processes
  • Assist in preparing materials for monthly performance reviews

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Accounting, related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 0–2 years of experience in financial analysis, accounting, or related roles
  • Prior experience in Consumer Products or Retail industry a plus
  • Demonstrates strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues and support resolution efforts
  • Solid analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and support actionable insights
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-based, and evolving environment while managing multiple priorities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly present financial information
  • Proficient Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and basic financial modeling
  • Experience with Oracle, Hyperion, or similar financial systems preferred

What We'll Give You –

  • Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
  • Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
  • Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.
  • Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
  • Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
  • Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.
$66,000.00 - $89,100.00

When you’re the best, we’re the best. We instill an environment where employees feel engaged, satisfied and able to contribute their unique skills and talents while living and working as their authentic selves. We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future.

Vizient R&D is building new ventures that help healthcare organizations solve complex, high-impact problems. These ventures often begin with ambiguity: emerging client needs, early ideas, evolving business models, and cross-functional teams working quickly to determine what should exist and how to bring it to market responsibly.

We’re looking for a builder-minded product and execution leader to help turn that ambiguity into progress.

In this role, you’ll partner with venture leadership to move ideas from concept to validated product direction to early build execution. You’ll bring strong judgment, design awareness, client orientation, and operating discipline. You’ll also play a key role in structuring and driving client-facing workstreams, ensuring that client discovery, feedback, pilots, implementation planning, and executive touchpoints are tightly connected to venture strategy, product development, and our internal milestones.

This is a role for someone who can shape how early-stage ventures are discovered, designed, built, piloted, launched, and prepared to scale.

What you’ll do

  • Lead cross-functional execution across early-stage ventures, partnering with engineering, data science, commercial, legal, privacy, compliance, and operations teams.
  • Prepare and facilitate client working sessions, discovery conversations, pilot reviews, and executive touchpoints that build trust, alignment, and momentum.
  • Translate venture strategy, customer insight, and vision into clear priorities, roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Clarify customer problems, pressure-test assumptions, define MVPs, shape discovery plans, and keep teams focused on user, customer, and business value.
  • Design and run lightweight venture operating systems, including planning rhythms, build reviews, milestone tracking, launch readiness, risk reviews, and executive reporting.
  • Create clarity in ambiguous environments by surfacing the right questions, structuring decisions, and helping teams move forward without unnecessary process.
  • Help teams adopt modern ways of working, including customer discovery, rapid learning loops, agile delivery, disciplined experimentation, prototyping, and continuous improvement.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, resourcing constraints, and unclear ownership early, then drive practical solutions.

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have 10 or more years of experience leading complex work in product-led, technology-enabled, consulting, innovation, or venture-building environments.
  • Have operated as a product operations leader, product strategy lead, chief of staff, strategic program leader, venture operator, business operations leader, or senior cross-functional execution lead.
  • Have led client-facing workstreams and can translate client input into product, pilot, and go-to-market decisions.
  • Bring strong fluency across discovery, strategy, design tradeoffs, prioritization, MVP definition, launch readiness, experimentation, and success metrics.
  • Can bring structure to ambiguity without creating bureaucracy, moving easily between strategy and detail.
  • Have executive presence, low ego, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without needing to own every decision.

Strong candidates may also have

  • Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, data, analytics, AI, enterprise software, consulting, or other regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting zero-to-one or one-to-scale product development.
  • Experience introducing new tools, AI-enabled workflows, automation, prototyping methods, or knowledge management practices.
  • Experience partnering with commercial teams on market validation, customer feedback, launch planning, pricing, packaging, or go-to-market readiness.
  • A track record of improving how teams learn from customers, make product decisions, manage dependencies, communicate, and hold themselves accountable

At Vizient, we consider skills, experience, and organizational needs in our compensation approach. Geographic factors may adjust the range estimate and hires typically fall below the top range. JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Media Analyst supports media measurement, performance analysis, operational excellence, and audience strategy across the Driven Brands portfolio. This role partners closely with brand and media teams, agency partners, Analytics, CRM, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure media investments are measured accurately, performance insights are actionable, and best practices are consistently applied across brands.


The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and curious, with a strong understanding of digital media, measurement, audience performance, and marketing technology.

Key Responsibilities

Performance Analysis & Measurement

  • Analyze media, audience, and channel performance across brands to identify trends, opportunities, and risks.
  • Support development of recurring and ad hoc reporting, business reviews, and performance narratives.
  • Translate performance data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Partner with Analytics to support KPI development, reporting methodologies, measurement frameworks, and test-and-learn initiatives.
  • Investigate performance changes and help answer critical business questions around what happened and why.

Data Integrity & Media Operations

  • Validate media data across agency reporting, dashboards, platform reporting, and internal data sources.
  • Identify and resolve reporting discrepancies, tracking issues, and measurement gaps.
  • Support tagging, tracking, and attribution governance across media initiatives.
  • Partner with Analytics, Web, CRM, and agency teams to improve data quality and measurement consistency.
  • Maintain reporting standards, documentation, and operational processes that support accurate media measurement and benchmarking.

Audience Insights & Best Practices

  • Analyze audience performance and contribute insights that inform audience strategy development.
  • Support audience testing and evaluation of first-party data activation strategies.
  • Document audience learnings, performance trends, and best practices.
  • Help identify opportunities to scale successful approaches across brands.
  • Support development and adoption of portfolio-wide standards for audience activation, reporting, and operations.

Agency & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Review agency reporting, analyses, and recommendations for quality, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Support performance reviews, testing roadmaps, and measurement initiatives.
  • Partner with Brand, Media, Analytics, CRM, Web, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on reporting, measurement, and audience initiatives.
  • Surface significant risks, data issues, opportunities, and learnings to leadership.
  • Contribute to portfolio-level reporting, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement efforts.

Qualifications Required

  • 4+ years of experience in paid media, media analytics, marketing analytics, performance marketing, or digital marketing.
  • Strong understanding of paid media channels, including Search, Social, Programmatic, Video, Traditional and Emerging Media.
  • Experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), campaign tagging frameworks, and digital measurement implementation.
  • Knowledge of attribution, conversion tracking, pixels, UTM governance, and media measurement best practices.
  • Experience working with agency partners and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with GA4, Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting platforms.
  • Experience with audience analysis, CRM data, CDPs, or first-party data activation.
  • Experience supporting testing, incrementality, attribution, or measurement initiatives.
  • Experience in a portfolio brand or franchise environment.
  • Agency experience or experience supporting agency-managed media programs.

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Gen-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Gen Interpreter
Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $1.25 - $1.40 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Gen Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Genand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inGenand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

The Solution Architect, Technology Ecosystem Partners Europe GTM is a technically elite, partner-focused professional who serves as the primary technical bridge between CrowdStrike and our Integration Partner ecosystem. You will drive the design, delivery, enablement & Go To Market of integrations built on the CrowdStrike Falcon Platform — helping partners unlock its full potential while accelerating joint go-to-market success. At CrowdStrike, we're on a mission to stop breaches. This role directly advances that mission by expanding the Falcon Platform's reach through a world-class partner ecosystem. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical expertise, cybersecurity, and strategic partnerships, this role is for you.

Role Scope

This role supports all Go To Market functions for the European market supporting the Technical Alliances organization.

  • CrowdStrike has Go To Market / Revenue generation targets for certain partners in the technology ecosystem. You will be responsible for assisting the Business Development Managers meet their quota goals. Think of this role as a sales engineer, but for partner activity.

  • OEM/Embedded Partners — Similar to above but for embedded products. Focus on Sales Engineering-style go-to-market support including technical demos, proof-of-value execution, and RFI/RFP responses.

What You'll Do:

  • Provide Sales Engineering support including technical demos, proof-of-value (POV) execution, and RFI/RFP responses.

  • Engage with partner sales and technical teams to support joint selling motions and accelerate deal progression.

  • Design, build, and validate integrations between partner technologies and the CrowdStrike Falcon Platform against defined standards and best practices.

  • Assist partners with evaluation and Not-for-Resale (NFR) environments including installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and product training.

  • Build and maintain partner demo environments including demo scenarios that effectively showcase joint solution value.

  • Document integration patterns, best practices, and reference architectures for partner and internal use.

  • Contribute technical content to the CrowdStrike partner portal and integration catalog.

  • Provide technical feedback to CrowdStrike Product teams based on partner integration experiences and field observations.

Enablement & Training

  • Provide inputs to the technical enablement team to build and improve training content for partners.

  • Serve as the technical liaison between internal CrowdStrike teams and partners to facilitate collaboration and remove blockers.

  • Participate in events such as security conferences, lunch & learns, and partner-sponsored events.

Operations & Innovation

  • Track and report on partner integration health, adoption metrics, escalation trends, and field activities.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable, low-touch partner onboarding experiences through automation and tooling.

  • Identify and incorporate agentic AI solutions to improve integration workflows, partner enablement, and overall operational efficiency.

What You'll Need:

Experience

  • 5+ years of technical experience in cybersecurity, solution architecture, or sales engineering.

  • Prior experience working in or with a partner, channel, or alliance ecosystem.

  • Experience in a security-focused solution architect or sales engineer role.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple partner engagements simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage a variety of audiences including senior executives.

  • Professional proficiency in English is required; additional European language(s) are a plus (German, French, Spanish, Italian).

  • Ability to travel predominantly within the EMEA region and sometimes global as required, including CrowdStrike SKOs and major partner events.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Technical Skills

  • Strong technical foundation in modern security platforms and at least several of the following domains:

  • Endpoint Defense

  • Modern Malware Lifecycle

  • Threat Intelligence

  • Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Endpoint Management

  • Cloud Security & Cloud Operations

  • SIEM, SOAR, or XDR platform integrationsExperience with one or more modern programming languages: Go, Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or equivalent.

  • Experience with data consumption capabilities including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhook-based integration patterns, scripting, MCP, and common data exchange formats (JSON, XML, etc.).

  • Proficiency in scripting languages including PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python.

  • Demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) to accelerate integration development and operational workflows.

  • Familiarity with GDPR, EU data protection and sovereignty requirements as they apply to cloud and security platform integrations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CrowdStrike SDKs: FalconPy, PSFalcon, GoFalcon, or FalconJS

  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CEH, Security+, or equivalent.


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

raw.description:
Build and run the GHL systems that turn leads into members and keep members coming back — and be the go-to support for the gym team using them.

About the Role

Seamless Assist places AI-fluent virtual assistants with growing businesses and builds the automation systems they run. We are hiring a GoHighLevel Specialist on behalf of our client, a US-based gym business. This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in the Philippines.

The gym runs its lead follow-up, trial bookings, member communication, and retention campaigns through GoHighLevel. This hire owns that platform end to end — building the automations that drive memberships and supporting the owner and front-desk team who use it every day.

Culture: owner-led, fast-moving fitness business. Clear ownership, proactive communication, and steady improvement over perfection.

Role Details

  • Industry: Health & Fitness — Gym
  • Reports to: Gym Owner
  • Type: Full-time · 40 hours/week
  • Hours: US Eastern Time (EST) business hours
  • Rate: TBD
  • Location: Remote — Philippines
  • Tools: GoHighLevel (GHL), Zapier / Make / n8n, gym management software (e.g., Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner), Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Google Workspace

Role Overview

Every lead, trial, and member touchpoint at the gym runs through GoHighLevel. The GHL Specialist will design and maintain those systems — from the first ad inquiry to the membership renewal — and provide responsive, first-line support to the gym owner and staff.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between building and supporting in the same day: fixing a broken trial-booking workflow in the morning, walking the front desk through the pipeline after lunch, and documenting both so it doesn't happen twice. The right person treats every support request as a signal of what to systematize next.

Key Responsibilities

GHL Automation & Build

  • Build and maintain lead nurture workflows — speed-to-lead SMS/email, trial class and intro session booking, and follow-up for leads who don't book
  • Automate the member journey — class and appointment reminders, no-show follow-up, new-member onboarding, and milestone check-ins
  • Run retention and reactivation campaigns — lapsed and frozen members, expiring memberships, failed payments, and win-back offers
  • Set up and manage pipelines, calendars, forms, surveys, landing pages/funnels, custom fields, and tags
  • Build and send email and SMS campaigns — promotions, challenges, events, and monthly member newsletters
  • Automate review requests and referral campaigns to grow the gym's reputation
  • Integrate GHL with the gym's management software, payment tools, and ad lead sources (Facebook/Instagram lead forms) via native integrations, Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks

Customer Support

  • Serve as first-line GHL support for the gym owner and front-desk/sales staff
  • Manage and respond to member and lead inquiries in the GHL Conversations inbox (SMS, email, social DMs) within agreed response times
  • Troubleshoot issues: broken workflows, failed sends, calendar sync errors, A2P/10DLC and email deliverability problems, integration failures
  • Train gym staff on using GHL — pipelines, conversations, booking, and reporting — through live walkthroughs and short recorded videos
  • Escalate billing, platform-level bugs, or out-of-scope requests to the gym owner with a clear summary

Reporting, Documentation & Improvement

  • Build dashboards that track leads, trial bookings, show rates, conversions to membership, and retention
  • Write SOPs and how-to guides for every recurring build and support issue
  • Audit the account for broken, duplicate, or unused workflows and recommend clean-up
  • Track recurring issues and propose automations or fixes that remove them at the source
  • Use AI tools to speed up campaign copy, troubleshooting, and documentation

Who Will Succeed

"Builds it right, explains it simply, and fixes the root cause — not just the ticket."

  • Has built real GHL automations for live businesses — ideally gyms, studios, or other membership businesses
  • Understands how a gym makes money: leads, trials, memberships, retention
  • Patient and clear with busy, non-technical owners and staff — explains a workflow without jargon
  • Systems thinker who documents as they go and hates fixing the same problem twice
  • Takes initiative — spots what is broken or missing and raises it before the owner does

Experience & Skills

Required

  • GHL expertise: 2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience building workflows, pipelines, funnels, and campaigns for live businesses
  • Customer support: 1+ year providing customer or technical support (tickets, live chat, calls, or client success)
  • Integrations: Working knowledge of Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks to connect GHL with other tools
  • AI fluency: Actively uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to build, write, and troubleshoot faster — specific tools and use cases confirmed at screening
  • Time zone compatibility: Able to work US Eastern Time (EST) business hours from the Philippines
  • Strong communication: Exceptional written and spoken English — clear, friendly, and concise with owners, staff, and members; assessed at screening
  • Deliverability: Understanding of email and SMS deliverability, including A2P 10DLC registration
  • Remote setup: Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated workspace

Preferred

  • Experience with gyms, fitness studios, or other membership-based businesses
  • Experience with gym management software (Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner, or similar)
  • GHL Admin certification
  • Familiarity with GHL Conversation AI / AI Employee features
  • Experience running Facebook/Instagram lead-gen campaigns into GHL

raw.description:
Revizto enables the people behind the world’s most important structures to do their best work. We connect architects, engineers, contractors, and owners in one shared 2D/3D environment to help deliver complex projects on time and on budget. From airports and hospitals to data centers and large-scale infrastructure, Revizto supports industry leaders in reducing risk, improving collaboration, and delivering better project outcomes.

Built on a gaming engine, Revizto is designed to handle the scale and complexity of modern construction projects while remaining fast, reliable, and accessible across devices and environments — whether teams are in the office or on site.

Key Responsibilities & Requirements

  • Security Monitoring & Investigation: Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts and incidents across cloud, endpoint, and SaaS environments, ensuring timely identification and assessment of potential threats.
  • Incident Response Management: Lead and coordinate security incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and preparation of comprehensive post-incident reports.
  • Threat Detection Engineering: Develop, test, and continuously refine security detection rules to improve accuracy, reduce false positives, and maintain detection coverage aligned with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Proactive Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive threat-hunting activities across cloud, endpoint, and identity telemetry to identify suspicious behavior, emerging threats, and potential security compromises.
  • Security Log Analysis: Analyze and correlate security logs and telemetry from AWS, Microsoft Azure/Entra ID, Kubernetes, endpoints, and SaaS applications to detect and investigate potential security incidents.
  • Cloud Security & Vulnerability Management: Investigate cloud security findings and vulnerability alerts, collaborate with relevant system owners, and support timely remediation of identified security risks.
  • Security Logging & Visibility: Maintain the health, completeness, and reliability of existing security log sources while identifying and onboarding additional sources to improve monitoring and detection coverage.
  • Incident Response Documentation: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve incident response runbooks and escalation procedures to ensure consistent and effective handling of security events.
Requirements
  • Professional Experience: At least 3 years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, or security detection role.
  • SIEM & EDR Technologies: Practical experience working with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions, preferably Microsoft Sentinel, and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms, preferably CrowdStrike Falcon.
  • Detection Engineering & Query Languages: Ability to write, analyze, optimize, and tune security detection queries using Kusto Query Language (KQL) or similar query languages.
  • Cybersecurity Fundamentals: Solid understanding of common cyberattack techniques, threat behaviors, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework, combined with a strong foundation in AWS and Azure cloud security principles.
  • End-to-End Incident Response: Proven experience managing security incidents throughout their entire lifecycle, from initial alert investigation and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reporting.
  • Security Frameworks & Standards: Knowledge of established information security frameworks and standards, including ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, and SOC 2.
  • English Proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or higher proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience conducting proactive threat-hunting activities to identify and investigate potential security threats.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and container security principles, including common risks and security considerations in containerized environments.
  • Basic scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to support security investigations, analysis, and operational tasks.
  • One or more relevant professional certifications, such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCTI, Microsoft SC-200, or CrowdStrike CCFA/CCFH.
Personal & Professional Competencies
  • Composure Under Pressure: Ability to remain calm, structured, and focused when managing security incidents and working under time-sensitive conditions.
  • Communication & Reporting: Strong written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain security incidents, technical findings, and their impact to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Collaboration & Ownership: A proactive team player who can work effectively both independently and collaboratively, take ownership of responsibilities, and continuously identify opportunities to improve security processes.
  • Relationship Building: Ability to establish and maintain strong, productive working relationships with colleagues across teams and at all organizational levels.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Security Operations Engineer to join our Information Security team and play a key role in protecting Revizto's cloud infrastructure, endpoints, and SaaS environments.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of identifying, investigating, and responding to security threats, ensuring that potential risks are detected and addressed effectively. You will take ownership of security incidents throughout their lifecycle, continuously improve threat detection capabilities, and proactively identify vulnerabilities and emerging threats.

Working closely with Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams, you will contribute to strengthening our overall security posture, enhancing detection coverage, and reducing incident detection and response times. This is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful security challenges and directly contribute to the protection and resilience of Revizto's technology environment.

  • Company-wide trips, including Armenia in 2023 and Switzerland in 2025, with more to come

** EventMobi is a remote-first company and this is a fully remote position. You may reside anywhere in Canada provided you are able to accommodate Eastern time working hours.

ABOUT YOU

Your events experience goes beyond internal company gatherings. You’ve worked in a professional events environment — a conference, association, agency, or corporate events team — and you think in run-of-shows, registration flows, and attendee journeys. You understand the full event lifecycle, from planning and logistics through on-site execution and post-event wrap-up. Extra credit if you’ve worked directly with clients or attendees and know what it takes to deliver a seamless event experience.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US?

We are an award-winning event tech startup with teams in Toronto, Berlin, and Manila, proudly serving thousands of customers worldwide. Our commitment to innovation drives us to continuously enhance our products, keeping us at the forefront of the latest event technology trends.

As an Event Success Manager at EventMobi, you’ll play a key role in empowering our customers’ success. Acting as their strategic advisor, you’ll spend your days proactively educating, onboarding, strategizing, problem-solving, and implementing cutting-edge technology and production solutions for our top-tier clients. Collaboration is at the heart of your role—you’ll work closely with our Account Management, Product, and Customer Support teams to ensure our customers not only love using EventMobi but return year after year.

WHAT YOUR WORK WILL FOCUS ON:

  • Serve as a trusted partner and strategic advisor to professional event planners and marketers at large corporations and associations, helping them implement event technology and execute successful events.
  • Lead customer onboarding, strategy sessions, and relationship-building to drive adoption and value generation from EventMobi products.
  • Guide customers through technical product training with an events-first mindset — delivering hands-on enablement that prepares teams to execute high-impact events on our platform.
  • Manage full-service event contracts end-to-end, overseeing multiple concurrent events with varying scopes, timelines, and complexity.
  • Lead proactive project management across the entire event lifecycle — from planning and build through live execution and post-event follow-up.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Customer Support, Product, AV, and Sales) to coordinate requirements, resolve issues, and deliver seamless event experiences.
  • Monitor customer health and success metrics, identify risks early, and take action to drive adoption, retention, and long-term success.
  • Conduct regular customer touchpoints including strategy sessions and quarterly reviews to align on outcomes and optimize future events.
  • Maintain accurate account, project, and communication records in HubSpot and internal tools.
  • Support live events as needed, including occasional evenings, weekends, or travel for on-site or hybrid event support.
  • Share customer feedback and improvement ideas with internal teams to continuously enhance processes, products, and the overall customer experience.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience planning or coordinating professional B2B events: conferences, trade shows, corporate meetings, or association events.
    *Experience with internal company events alone does not meet this requirement.
  • Demonstrated experience using event technology — registration platforms, event apps, or virtual event platforms. Familiarity with tools such as Cvent, Eventbrite, Bizzabo, Hopin, or similar is required.
  • A genuine interest in technology and its impact on the events industry.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical event organizers.
  • Top-notch organizational skills: you manage multiple projects simultaneously, document thoroughly, and follow through consistently.
  • An empathetic, problem-solving mindset — you care about delivering great outcomes for your clients.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • 2-year college diploma or 4-year degree in hospitality or events management.
  • Experience working with HubSpot, Salesforce, or other CRMs.
  • Previous experience supporting customer onboarding for technical products or SaaS platforms

WHAT WILL YOU GET FROM EVENTMOBI?

  • Compensation: Pay range between $65K and $80K CAD, according to experience. + Stock Options + Benefits
  • Time-Off: 3-weeks vacation + 1-week Sick Days + 3-summer days + your birthday is a holiday (seriously! log-off and hang out with the fam or go do something fun) + opportunities to meet your co-workers in person throughout the year
  • Benefits: Dental, Health, Life, Mental Health Consultations (Green Shield Health Inc)
  • Tools: Top of the line hardware and the best collaboration software for remote work so you can be as productive as possible while working from home
  • The Best Coworkers Ever: If you ask anyone that has worked at EventMobi, they will tell you that their fellow Mobiers are the best part of their experience! Don't underestimate the positive impact of caring co-workers have on your everyday happiness.

REMOTE WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS:

  • You have a safe, comfortable, and ergonomic workspace and working environment - a private and quiet workspace is a vital requirement for doing your best work!
  • You have a reliable internet connection capable of participating in video calls, with at least 30Mbps download speed

ABOUT EVENTMOBI

We're focused on building the most comprehensive event management platform to help conference organizers create engaging event experiences. We believe live events bring people together and enable positive change. Over 30,000+ events in 70+ countries from major brands such as Shoppers Drug Mart, to amazing non-profits such as American Psychiatric Nurses Association and Canadian Real Estate Association have trusted EventMobi’s suite of software technology to manage their events and engage their attendees.

If you are interested in seeing EventMobi in action, check out some of the videos below:

  • The Experience Manager Platform
  • The EventMobi Mobile Event App
  • The Product Tour
  • Top brands and organizations from around the world have used EventMobi’s event app technology to create incredible event experiences - hear directly from our customers.

APPLICATION NOTE

As part of your application, you will be asked to describe a professional event you planned or coordinated — including the type of event, number of attendees, and the tools you used. This is a required field and helps us understand your events background.

EventMobi is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Autoscribe Corporation is a trusted leader in payment processing and consumer finance solutions, serving businesses nationwide since 1989. We specialize in high-volume consumer-to-business payment processing and fraud-identification services, helping organizations streamline transactions, reduce risk, and improve cash flow.

Our culture blends financial discipline with innovation—we’re a company that values precision, accountability, and forward-thinking problem solving. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a Controller who is not only technically strong, but also excited to build, optimize, and lead within a dynamic fintech environment.

The Opportunity
Autoscribe is seeking an experienced, analytical, and hands-on Controller to lead our accounting function. This role is central to the financial integrity of our business—overseeing high-volume transaction accounting, ensuring accuracy in earnings and cost of goods sold, and strengthening the systems that support our growth.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Controller will play a key role in financial strategy, operational execution, and decision support. This is a high-impact leadership position ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, detail-driven environment and wants to help shape the financial future of a growing organization.

What You’ll Do

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Lead all day-to-day accounting operations including AP, AR, general ledger, and payroll
  • Ensure accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of accounting processes

Payment Reconciliation & Transaction Integrity

  • Oversee reconciliation of high-volume payment flows and trust account disbursements

  • Serve as a critical control point for transaction accuracy and financial integrity

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with GAAP

Internal Controls & Compliance

  • Partner with the Chief Compliance Officer to strengthen internal controls and fraud prevention measures
  • Ensure compliance with PCI-DSS, SOC 2 standards, and applicable regulations

Treasury & Cash Management

  • Manage cash concentration and movement from trust accounts
  • Oversee forecasting and liquidity planning to support operational needs

Tax & External Coordination

  • Act as liaison with external tax partners to ensure timely and accurate filings

Strategic Finance & Business Support

  • Analyze program and campaign performance, including yield and profitability
  • Support annual budgeting, variance analysis, and financial planning
  • Provide insights that guide growth and operational decision-making

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team
  • Build a culture of accountability, precision, and continuous improvement

What You Bring

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance (required)
  • CPA, CMA, or CCM strongly preferred

Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • 4+ years in a leadership or supervisory role

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with accounting systems
  • SQL or data querying experience is a plus

Knowledge

  • Strong command of GAAP
  • Familiarity with tax considerations including Section 179

raw.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Role Overview

As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you will operate at the front lines of innovation — embedded directly with multiple cross-functional teams to rapidly design, architect, prototype, and deploy solutions that solve their highest-priority problems. This is not a traditional engineering role with long delivery cycles: you will be expected to go from concept to working prototype in days, not months, while maintaining enterprise-grade standards for quality, security, and scalability.

You will act as the embedded technical owner across several teams simultaneously — diagnosing their workflow and data problems, then architecting and building the fix yourself. You will use modern AI coding assistants day-to-day to design and implement solutions, and you're expected to be fluent extending that toolset — building custom plugins/skills, redesigning data pipelines and data flows, and deploying agents to production via AWS Bedrock AgentCore. At the Staff level, your impact extends beyond any single team: you define the patterns and playbooks other engineers use to deliver, and you act as the escalation point for the hardest technical and stakeholder problems across the portfolio.

You bring an exceptional combination of skills: deep hands-on engineering experience across AI agents, data architecture, and full-stack development, and the interpersonal skills to earn trust, drive alignment, and influence without authority across multiple teams at once. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding a system architecture with senior stakeholders and shipping production code the same afternoon.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Lead solution design for complex, cross-functional data and AI problems — from initial discovery through to technical blueprint
  • Evaluate and select the right tools and architecture for each problem — no single stack applies across every team you support, so you must be able to reason across different platforms, data sources, and integration patterns
  • Define and communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, and delivery approaches to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Design scalable, modular systems that balance speed with enterprise standards for reliability, security, and maintainability
  • Create clear technical documentation: architecture diagrams, data flow maps, API contracts, and solution briefs
  • Establish reusable architecture patterns and reference designs that other engineers adopt across engagements

AI-Assisted Solution Delivery

  • Use AI coding assistants as your primary development environment for day-to-day solution building — from prototyping through production implementation
  • Build and maintain custom plugins/skills for your AI coding assistant that package reusable capabilities for recurring problems across teams

About RAB2B

RAB2B is a global B2B marketing agency that partners with ambitious brands to drive measurable growth. We combine strategic thinking, media excellence, and operational rigor to deliver integrated solutions across markets. Our culture is built on accountability, clarity, and performance, empowering our teams to lead with ownership while collaborating across disciplines.

About the role

The Campaign Manager (Performance Analyst) is responsible for the implementation, monitoring, and optimization of digital campaigns across platforms, ensuring accuracy in execution, data integrity, and performance delivery.

As part of the performance hub, this role supports campaign delivery across multiple accounts, executing against defined strategies and adhering to established standards, processes, and playbooks.

The Campaign Manager focuses on execution excellence, working under the guidance of the Supervisor of Performance, and plays a critical role in ensuring campaigns are launched, managed, and optimized with precision.

What you'll do

Campaign Implementation

  • Execute digital campaigns across platforms including:
    • Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube)
    • Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn)
    • Programmatic platforms (Trade Desk, StackAdapt, DV360, or equivalent)
  • Build campaigns in alignment with approved plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Ensure proper setup of:
    • Campaign structures
    • Naming conventions
    • UTMs and tracking parameters

Monitoring & Optimization

  • Monitor campaign performance daily to ensure delivery against KPIs and investment targets.
  • Optimize campaigns based on performance metrics such as CPA, CTR, CVR, ROAS, and delivery pacing.
  • Adjust bids, budgets, audiences, and creatives to improve performance.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and performance issues, and escalate when necessary.

Budget & Pacing Control

  • Track campaign pacing and ensure alignment with planned investment.
  • Flag under-delivery, overspend, or performance risks proactively.
  • Support reconciliation between planned and executed budgets.

Tracking & Execution Support

  • Support the implementation of tracking, including pixels, tags, and conversion events, following defined specifications.
  • Validate basic tracking functionality and ensure campaigns are properly instrumented.
  • Escalate complex tracking or data discrepancies to the Supervisor.

Quality Assurance (QA)

  • Execute QA processes based on established playbooks and standards.
  • Verify campaign setup, assets, links, and configurations prior to launch.
  • Ensure campaigns meet internal and client quality requirements before and after deployment.

Reporting & Insights

  • Build and maintain campaign performance reports and dashboards.
  • Analyze campaign data and provide insights on performance trends.
  • Support post-campaign reporting and documentation of learnings.
  • Prepare inputs for monthly reporting and billing processes.

Operational Support

  • Support billing and reconciliation processes, including campaign closures and invoicing inputs.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of campaign setups, changes, and performance.
  • Ensure compliance with internal processes, policies, and operational standards.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with Planners and Associate Directors to align execution with strategy.
  • Collaborate with creative, analytics, and data teams to ensure proper implementation.

Follow guidance from the Supervisor on optimization, technical setup, and troubleshooting.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in digital campaign management, performance marketing, or media buying.
  • Hands-on experience executing campaigns across multiple digital platforms.

Technical Expertise (Mandatory)

  • Strong experience with:
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads Manager
    • TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads or similar platforms
    • Programmatic platforms such as Trade Desk, StackAdapt, DV360, or equivalent ¿
  • Solid understanding of:
    • Campaign structure and optimization techniques
    • Audience targeting and segmentation
    • Conversion tracking (pixels, UTMs, tagging)
    • Digital media KPIs and performance metrics

Technical Skills

  • Intermediate to advanced Excel skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and identify performance trends.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards.
