Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Overview of the Role

As an Engagement Delivery Senior Manager on the Missionforce Professional Services team, you will serve as a hands-on delivery leader, project manager, and trusted advisor across a portfolio of Public Sector engagements. Operating as an individual contributor, this role focuses directly on project delivery execution, customer relationship management, and project health—without direct people leader responsibilities.
You will support delivery health across assigned engagements, partnering closely with the Portfolio Delivery Leader (PDL), project teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure work is delivered with quality, predictability, and alignment to mission outcomes. You are a builder of trust—with customers, with delivery teams, and with internal partners. You bring credibility through proximity to the work, and you help teams navigate the unique demands of a Public Sector, cleared environment.

Responsibilities

Delivery Execution & Engagement Health

  • Delivery Governance: Own and manage the day-to-day delivery health of assigned engagements, ensuring strict adherence to Salesforce Professional Services Methodology (SPSM) standards, project gates, and outcome-based delivery practices.
  • Project Planning & Control: Create, lead, and review project plans; monitor timelines and dependencies; adjust schedules and plans as needed; track utilization of resources against prioritization and budget.
  • Program & Project Scope: Lead one or two large enterprise projects or multiple small-to-medium interrelated projects requiring complex multi-functional collaboration at the program level.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Monitor project health signals (RYG/PSA Pulses) to proactively identify, track, and resolve project risks before they become issues.
  • Project Recovery: Lead or support project recovery efforts on at-risk engagements; partner with the PDL on escalations that require additional oversight.
  • Methodology & Execution: Adopt a standardized development lifecycle methodology across engagements; oversee end-to-end implementation planning, issue management, risk tracking, and organizational change.

Customer Engagement & Stakeholder Management

  • Primary Interface: Serve as the primary delivery relationship owner and interface for customer stakeholders at the program management, operational, and executive levels—building trust through consistent communication, transparency, and follow-through.
  • Advisory & Strategy: Establish and maintain trusted advisor relationships with client stakeholders by providing vision, future product roadmapping, and driving business process improvements.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate client review sessions, requirement-gathering workshops, and status meetings.
  • Escalation & Alignment: Lead difficult conversations regarding scope, budget, timelines, and resourcing; formally document and communicate outcomes while resolving partner concerns.
  • Value Realization: Contribute to value realization conversations by helping customers connect delivery progress to mission outcomes and KPIs.

Technical Design & Quality Oversight

  • Technical Alignment: Facilitate and guide the creation of technical design documents for complex projects by collaborating directly with Technical Architects and Developers.
  • Quality & Deliverables: Responsible for all project deliverables, reviewing work products prepared by the team prior to submission to the client.
  • Testing & UAT: As necessary, write and review QA and UAT test scripts; coordinate and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with end users to secure formal sign-offs.
  • Technology Adoption: Identify opportunities to demonstrate and leverage the full range of Salesforce technologies (e.g., Agentforce).

Cross-Functional Collaboration & GTM Support

  • GTM & Sales Alignment: Partner closely with the PDL on sales-to-delivery handoffs to ensure scoped commitments are honored in execution.
  • Pre-Sales Collaboration: Collaborate with Solution Consulting, Technical Consulting, and Services Sales partners to support pre-sales engagements, LOE reviews, and pursuit activities.
  • Unified Delivery: Represent the "One Salesforce" delivery perspective in multi-stakeholder environments, including government agency partners and subcontractors.
  • Operational Excellence: Manage and track engagement KPIs, project milestones, and delivery metrics; maintain accurate timecard entry/approvals and source-of-truth data in PSA/Org62.
  • Practice Enablement: Contribute to internal practice-building efforts, enablement initiatives, and delivery standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Delivery & Project Leadership: 8-10+ years of project management experience leading enterprise-scale CRM projects or professional services engagements in complex environments.
  • Project Execution: Demonstrated leadership running project teams, budgeting, scheduling, and negotiating contract commitments.
  • Salesforce Knowledge: Solid knowledge of the Salesforce product suite and implementation experience across Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery frameworks.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional executive presence, conflict management, and written/verbal communication skills with program managers and senior stakeholders.
  • Public Sector Acumen: Familiarity with the procurement, compliance, governance, and delivery nuances of government programs, including fixed-price contract management.
  • Security Clearance: Active SECRET Security Clearance (or higher) required (Top Secret preferred); must be a U.S. Citizen without dual citizenship.
  • Travel & Work Environment: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and travel to client sites for on-site delivery, as needed.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Public Sector / Government Experience: Direct experience delivering technology programs within federal, state, or local government entities.
  • Agile & Project Management Credentials: Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe 6 Agilist Certification, PMP, or PgMP certification preferred.
  • Salesforce Certifications: Agentforce Specialist, AI Associate/Specialist, Public Sector Solutions Consultant, or equivalent preferred.
  • AI Fluency: Familiarity with agentic AI applications, data governance, and trusted AI principles in public sector environments.
  • Program Scale: Experience managing and delivering complex programs in the $5M–$50M range.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

raw.description:
About AdvantixxRCM
AdvantixxRCM is a healthcare revenue cycle management company providing comprehensive medical billing, accounts receivable management, denial management, credentialing, payer enrollment, and revenue cycle solutions to healthcare providers.

We are seeking an experienced Operations Manager to lead the day-to-day operations of our growing RCM organization. This is a hands-on leadership position responsible for managing employees, workflows, client performance, productivity, quality, and operational results.

Position Summary

The Operations Manager is responsible for the overall daily operations of AdvantixxRCM and for ensuring that revenue cycle teams operate efficiently, accurately, and in compliance with company and client requirements.

The ideal candidate is an experienced healthcare operations leader who understands the complete medical revenue cycle and can independently manage teams, solve operational problems, analyze performance, develop processes, and hold employees accountable for results.

This position requires someone who can run the operation—not simply supervise employees.

Essential Responsibilities

Operations & Leadership

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of AdvantixxRCM.
  • Supervise medical billing, A/R, denials, payment posting, credentialing, eligibility, authorization, and administrative teams.
  • Establish daily, weekly, and monthly operational priorities.
  • Assign workloads and ensure appropriate staffing coverage.
  • Monitor employee productivity, accuracy, attendance, and performance.
  • Conduct team meetings, coaching sessions, and performance reviews.
  • Identify staffing needs and participate in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, and onboarding.
  • Develop supervisors and team leads as the organization grows.
  • Address performance deficiencies and coordinate corrective action when necessary.
  • Create an accountable, professional, results-driven work environment.
  • Escalate significant operational, compliance, financial, or client matters to executive leadership.

Revenue Cycle Management

  • Oversee the complete revenue cycle from charge entry and claim submission through final payment and account resolution.
  • Monitor claim submission and clearinghouse activity.
  • Monitor clean-claim and first-pass acceptance rates.
  • Oversee insurance A/R follow-up.
  • Monitor aging reports and develop strategies for reducing outstanding A/R.
  • Oversee denial management, corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals.
  • Monitor payment posting and reconciliation.
  • Ensure claims are submitted and followed up within payer timely-filing requirements.
  • Identify underpayments and reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Monitor recurring payer issues and develop corrective strategies.
  • Coordinate credentialing and payer enrollment activities.
  • Work collaboratively with coding, eligibility, authorization, and billing teams.
  • Identify revenue leakage and opportunities to improve collections.

Client Management

  • Serve as an operational point of contact for assigned AdvantixxRCM clients.
  • Oversee implementation and onboarding of new healthcare practices.
  • Ensure contractual services and client expectations are met.
  • Conduct client performance meetings when required.
  • Review client A/R, collections, denials, and billing performance.
  • Prepare and present operational reports.
  • Respond to client concerns professionally and promptly.
  • Coordinate resolution of escalated billing and reimbursement issues.
  • Maintain strong client relationships and support client retention.
  • Identify opportunities to improve or expand services.

Performance & Analytics

The Operations Manager will monitor key RCM performance indicators, including:

  • Clean claim rate
  • First-pass acceptance/resolution rate
  • Denial rate
  • Days in A/R
  • A/R aging
  • A/R over 90 days
  • Net collection rate
  • Claim submission turnaround
  • Payment posting turnaround
  • Denial resolution
  • Appeal recovery
  • Employee productivity
  • Quality/accuracy
  • Client performance
  • Client satisfaction and retention

The Operations Manager is expected to use data to identify problems and implement measurable corrective actions.

Process Improvement

  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Standardize workflows across departments and clients.
  • Identify inefficient processes and implement improvements.
  • Establish quality-control procedures.
  • Develop operational dashboards and reporting systems.
  • Analyze denial and A/R trends to identify root causes.
  • Implement corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Assist leadership with automation and technology initiatives.
  • Ensure employees are appropriately trained on new processes.

Compliance & Quality

  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA and applicable privacy/security requirements.
  • Ensure appropriate handling and protection of PHI.
  • Promote compliant billing practices.
  • Coordinate internal quality and billing audits.
  • Ensure staff follow payer, client, and company requirements.
  • Monitor employee access to EHRs, payer portals, clearinghouses, and other systems.
  • Immediately escalate suspected billing irregularities, compliance concerns, privacy incidents, or material operational risks.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Minimum 5 years of healthcare revenue cycle, medical billing, or healthcare operations experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of supervisory or management experience.
  • Strong understanding of the complete healthcare revenue cycle.
  • Demonstrated experience managing medical billing and A/R operations.
  • Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance.
  • Strong knowledge of CMS-1500 professional claims.
  • Working knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, modifiers, EOBs, ERAs, CARC/RARC codes, and payer reimbursement processes.
  • Experience with claim denials, appeals, corrected claims, and insurance follow-up.
  • Experience working with clearinghouses and payer portals.
  • Ability to interpret A/R aging and RCM performance reports.
  • Strong leadership, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple departments, priorities, and client accounts simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Health Information Management, Finance, or related field.
  • CPC, CPB, CRCR, CCS, CHFP, or similar healthcare revenue cycle certification.
  • Previous management experience within an RCM company or multi-practice medical billing organization.
  • Experience managing remote and/or multi-location teams.
  • Experience implementing new medical practices or RCM clients.
  • Experience with credentialing and payer enrollment.
  • Experience with multiple EHR/Practice Management systems and clearinghouses.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a strong operator and leader who takes ownership.

The successful candidate should be able to identify a problem, investigate the root cause, develop a solution, assign responsibility, establish a deadline, and follow through until the issue is resolved.

This position is ideal for someone who is comfortable being held accountable for the performance of an entire RCM operation and who can successfully lead teams without requiring constant direction from executive leadership.

  • Drafting documents including statements, pleadings and schedules of loss.
  • Securing early interim payments and appropriate rehabilitation.

• Optimising your client’s settlement.

  • Ability to work with a task-based case management system to ensure regular contact is maintained with all clients, providing exceptional customer service and managing their expectations.
  • Raising awareness of the department and developing your professional profile. We have close links with APIL, Headway, and SIA, you will be involved in supporting these organisations with networking and business development. For example, reporting cases, preparing articles and testimonials.
  • Supervision, mentoring and development of junior members of the team as appropriate.
  • Perform to a high level in a target orientated environment.
  • To undertake any other tasks as deemed relevant and reasonable by the business.

Key Performance Indicators

Your KPI’s and Objectives will be discussed and agreed with you on a one-to-one basis. You will have regular one-to-one meetings with your line manager to review your performance against these objectives and identify any areas for development and/or required support.

Person Specification

Essential

  • Qualified Solicitor or Fellow of CILEx with a minimum of 4 years post qualification experience or can demonstrate equivalent experience to charge and recover Grade B rates
  • Proven track record of dealing with serious injury claims; an experienced litigator with strong technical ability and practical knowledge of the court procedures.
  • Commitment to delivering excellent client care for each of our clients.
  • Excellent communication skills to include negotiation and objection handling.
  • Accountable for achieving objectives in a fast-paced environment whilst maintaining high standards of work quality and client care.
  • Competent working with a case management system and good knowledge of Excel and Word.
  • Good attention to detail and strong organisational skills.

Desirable

  • Team player who acts as a role model to your colleagues, including experience mentoring junior members of the team to develop their competence within multi track personal injury work.
  • Confident developing your professional profile and that of your firm within the personal injury field, existing links with associated bodies for example Headway, SIA and APIL.
  • Maintains a positive attitude, self-motivated and uses own initiative.
  • Robust - able to deal with changing circumstances and challenging situations whilst still achieving objectives.
  • Takes opportunities to develop and stretch yourself and be passionate about developing your career in personal injury.

Personal Development

There is the opportunity for high performing individuals to move into different departments across the business, to expand their knowledge, experience and develop a career within Minster Law.

Travel

Our clients are based throughout England and Wales and there will be a need for regular travel, for example to undertake meetings with clients and conferences with the multi-disciplinary teams of experts and counsel.

Salary Information

Equal Opportunities

We’re an equal opportunity and disability confident employer. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, neurodiversity, or disability status. raw.description:
Night Shift Project Manager — Localization, Translation, Interpreting & Sales

Company: Day Translations, Inc.

Position type: Full-time

Location: Remote — worldwide

Schedule: U.S. nighttime hours. Exact hours and applicable U.S. time zone will be confirmed during hiring.

Day Translations is a global translation and interpreting company. We help individuals, organizations, and businesses communicate worldwide through accurate translations, localization, interpreting, and tailored language solutions.

We are seeking a full-time Project Manager with strong sales experience and knowledge of localization, translation, and interpreting to join our night team.

This position combines project management, client service, and sales. You will manage language projects from inquiry through delivery, convert inquiries into paying clients, close deals with large interpreting clients, and help businesses sign up for phone interpreting services through Day Interpreting.

The ideal candidate can confidently lead client conversations, explain our services, negotiate effectively, and close business while keeping projects organized and on schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Manage localization, translation, and interpreting projects from initial inquiry and quoting through scheduling, delivery, and completion.
  • Lead sales conversations with prospective clients, understand their needs, recommend appropriate services, and close deals.
  • Pursue and close large interpreting opportunities, including ongoing service agreements with businesses and organizations.
  • Guide clients through signing up for Day Interpreting’s phone interpreting services, including explaining the platform, pricing, account setup, and next steps.
  • Conduct client calls, presentations, and platform demonstrations to support sales and onboarding.
  • Follow up proactively on inquiries, quotes, proposals, and pending agreements to move opportunities toward a decision.
  • Build relationships with decision-makers and identify opportunities for repeat business, expanded services, and long-term partnerships.
  • Prepare accurate quotes, proposals, project budgets, and achievable timelines.
  • Coordinate localization projects involving websites, software, applications, and digital content, including file preparation, linguist assignments, review, and delivery.
  • Coordinate translation projects, including translator and editor assignments, proofreading, formatting, and final quality checks.
  • Arrange on-site, telephone, and video interpreting assignments, confirming language pairs, subject matter, dates, time zones, locations, and technical requirements.
  • Confirm interpreter availability and readiness, manage scheduling changes, and arrange replacements when needed.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to client inquiries by phone, email, and chat.
  • Source qualified language professionals through approved freelancer databases and negotiate rates and deadlines.
  • Track project budgets and costs to maintain quality and profitability.
  • Maintain accurate project records in Plunet and sales activity in the company’s designated systems.
  • Monitor progress, resolve client and freelancer questions, and escalate urgent concerns when necessary.
  • Communicate actively with colleagues and provide clear handover notes between shifts.
  • Follow company policies, confidentiality requirements, and quality procedures.

Requirements

  • Strong sales experience, including a demonstrated ability to negotiate and close deals with large business clients.
  • Experience selling interpreting services or other business-to-business services, with the ability to manage longer sales conversations and multiple decision-makers.
  • Confidence conducting sales calls, presenting solutions, handling objections, following up, and asking for the sale.
  • Ability to explain phone interpreting services clearly and guide clients through Day Interpreting sign-up and onboarding.
  • Solid knowledge of localization and translation workflows, including project scoping, file requirements, linguist coordination, quality assurance, and delivery.
  • Understanding of interpreting services and logistics, including on-site, telephone, and video interpreting.
  • Experience in project management and customer service, preferably within the language services industry.
  • Familiarity with CAT tools such as Smartcat, memoQ, or Trados Studio.
  • Experience with Plunet or similar project management systems is preferred.
  • Advanced written and spoken English at a native or C1 level, plus fluency in at least one additional language.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, sales opportunities, and deadlines.
  • Excellent cross-cultural communication, professionalism, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and remain proactive and responsive throughout the night shift.
  • Reliable internet access and a quiet workspace suitable for client calls and demonstrations.
  • Consistent availability for full-time work during the assigned U.S. nighttime schedule.
  • A university degree in Business Administration, Translation, Localization, or a related field is preferred.

Professional Commitment

This position requires your full professional commitment during scheduled working hours. Job stacking and conflicting concurrent employment are not permitted. We monitor productivity and work activity, and any undisclosed conflicting employment may result in termination.

How to Apply

To be considered, you must complete both steps:

  1. Submit your application and provide complete answers to every application question. Include examples of your sales results, large client deals you have closed, and experience managing language projects.
  2. Complete the Emotional Intelligence and Wonderlic assessments after submitting your application.

Both steps are required to move forward in the evaluation process.

Candidates may be asked to complete a background check before hiring.

All application questions are mandatory. Incomplete or insufficient answers may result in disqualification or a request for clarification.

Role Overview
A healthcare-focused organization is seeking an ERP Systems Associate to support data-driven decision-making across supply chain and procurement functions. This role focuses on analyzing ERP and operational data to identify cost savings, optimize purchasing strategies, and improve overall supply chain performance.

The ideal candidate has experience in healthcare supply chain environments, strong analytical skills, and familiarity with ERP systems and reporting tools.

Key Responsibilities
Data Analysis & Insights

  • Analyze purchasing and supply chain data to identify trends, cost-saving opportunities, and performance improvements.
  • Support contract negotiations and renewals through cost/benefit analysis and spend insights.
  • Utilize benchmark data to identify savings opportunities and track progress against targets.

Reporting & Dashboards

  • Develop and maintain dashboards and KPI tracking for system-wide initiatives.
  • Administer reporting mechanisms to monitor supply chain performance and operational efficiency.
  • Support diversity reporting programs by tracking supplier spend and classification within ERP systems.

ERP & Data Management

  • Leverage ERP systems to extract, validate, and analyze clinical, financial, and operational data.
  • Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across reporting outputs.
  • Maintain knowledge of ERP functionality to support reporting and analytics requirements.

Stakeholder Support

  • Provide analytical support to supply chain teams and local markets for custom reporting needs.
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders and leadership.
  • Assist teams in identifying productivity improvements and cost optimization opportunities.

Process Improvement

  • Document methodologies and processes used in data analysis to ensure repeatability and transparency.
  • Enhance data collection, compilation, and reporting processes for efficiency and scalability.


Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare, IT, or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of experience in healthcare supply chain or a similar industry.
  • Hands-on experience using or supporting ERP systems.
  • Familiarity with healthcare terminology, supply products, and procurement processes.

Preferred:

  • Experience with product classification systems such as UNSPSC, UPN, or GTIN.
  • Additional experience in healthcare environments or shared services organizations.


Skills and Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to interpret large datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools such as Power BI.
  • High attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain insights to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder engagement skills.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Combines ERP systems, analytics, and healthcare supply chain expertise
  • Direct impact on cost savings and operational efficiency
  • Exposure to enterprise-level reporting and KPI tracking
  • Opportunity to work in a data-driven, high-impact environment

raw.description:
About Thunkable

Thunkable is the leading no-code and AI platform that empowers anyone to design, develop, and deploy powerful, native mobile applications without writing a single line of code. Our mission is to make app development accessible to everyone—transforming passive consumers into active creators of technology.

Founded in 2016 by Arun Saigal and Weihua Li, former members of the MIT App Inventor and MIT Scratch team, Thunkable now supports millions of users across 184 countries, including a quarter of Fortune 500 companies. We’re backed by Lightspeed, NEA, Owl Ventures, SV Angel, and Y Combinator.

Role Overview

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the front end of the sales pipeline. They turn target accounts and inbound interest into qualified, sales-ready meetings for Account Executives. The role blends outbound prospecting, inbound lead follow-up, and early-stage discovery, and success is measured almost entirely by pipeline created.

In one line:Find the right people, start the right conversations, qualify fit honestly, and hand AEs opportunities worth their time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect, educate, qualify, and develop Target Accounts and inbound leads to create sales-ready meetings and opportunities. This includes target market penetration, calling on CXOs, senior-level executives, trade show attendance, following up on marketing-generated leads, webinar and event follow-up, creative campaign and door opener outreach, and more
  • Interact with prospects via telephone, video correspondence, and email
  • Research accounts, identify key players, generate interest and develop accounts to stimulate opportunity
  • Disseminate opportunities to appropriate AE, educating each rep as necessary about the opportunity
  • Lead the discovery process by identifying the prospect’s pain points, while effectively setting the stage for the sales process
  • Effectively handle and overcome prospect objections with confidence
  • Become a trusted resource and develop productive relationships with prospects
  • Update lead scoring and prospect interaction in CRM to ensure efficient lead management
  • Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline targets
  • Provide closed-loop feedback to ensure continuous process optimization
  • Maintain professional internal and external relationships that meet our core values

Required Qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales, business development, or customer-facing role, ideally in SaaS or tech
  • High level of organization and attention to detail – You can read between the lines to identify the customer’s need while effectively taking & sharing notes. Then following up as needed with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Pre-call planning & research – Efficiently finding the needle in a haystack, such as the right decision maker or key tidbits of information that will inspire action from prospects
  • Opportunity qualification and objection handling – We want you to communicate like an empathetic human being. And determine if our platform is a right fit for the customers’ needs, then communicate it appropriately
  • Call and email structure and control – You’ll own the outreach of our company to potential customers. You will have free reign to tweak, tune, and craft content to ensure it hits the right target. You can communicate via phone and email effectively, and if changes are needed, you are driven to try new things
  • Effective time management – Stay on top of client conversations, while balancing new opportunities. You should be able to answer: everyone is important, but who gets prioritized?
  • Ability to handle relationships at all levels of an organization – Any foot in the door is a step forward. Can you communicate to start-up founders, developers, product managers, VPs, and C-level executives?
  • Consistent track record of achieving measurable sales goals in a fast-paced environment – This is a results-driven job.
  • Ability to work in a high-energy team environment – you bring excitement to every conversation and you’re genuinely enthusiastic about communicating with people
  • Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing, and presentation skills
  • The highest level of integrity

Shoulder Innovations is a medical device startup that is revolutionizing shoulder replacements. Led by a seasoned team with over a century of orthopedic expertise, we’ve developed a disruptive shoulder replacement system and secured substantial funding to drive rapid growth. (NYSE: SI).

We’re seeking entrepreneurial talent to join us on this exciting journey. Our culture is built on:

  • People First: Authentically human.
  • One Team: Empowered and aligned.
  • Innovation: Bold, creative, and daring.
  • Growth Mindset: Always curious.

Ready to make an impact in orthopedics? Let’s grow together!

We are seeking a Clinical Trial Associate who is responsible for administrative and other support related duties for clinical studies conducted by Shoulder Innovations. This position requires a good understanding of clinical study processes and regulatory standards such as Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and FDA regulations. This position will communicate with Principal Investigators and/or their research staff, support onboarding sites to the clinical study, participate in data monitoring and other tasks at the direction of the Associate Director of Clinical Affairs.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Provide comprehensive administrative support for clinical trial operations, including organizing, maintaining, and updating study documentation to ensure accuracy and completeness within the Trial Master File (TMF).
  • Manage and oversee documentation processes, ensuring all regulatory and compliance requirements are met and that files adhere to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) standards.
  • Assist in the preparation, review, and submission of Institutional Review Board (IRB) documents, ensuring timely approvals and compliance with ethical standards.
  • Monitor adherence to study protocols and regulatory guidelines, proactively identifying and addressing compliance gaps to maintain the integrity of the trial.
  • Support day-to-day trial operations, collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve operational issues and maintain smooth study progress.
  • Track and manage study data, including accurate handling of Case Report Forms (CRFs), ensuring data integrity and timely entry into relevant systems.
  • Monitor trial progress and performance metrics, maintaining effective communication with study sites, drafting detailed status reports, and escalating issues as needed.
  • Coordinate site communications, serving as a point of contact for inquiries and updates, and ensuring timely dissemination of information to stakeholders.
  • Perform additional tasks and responsibilities as assigned by the Associate Director of Clinical Affairs, contributing to the overall success of the study and supporting team objectives.

We believe to be successful as a Clinical Trial Associate, you will have the following:

  • Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of experience, education and training
  • 2+ years experience at the Sponsor or CRO level, or 5 years at the SMO or site level
  • Experience with medical device clinical studies preferred
  • Experience with shoulder arthroplasty or orthopedics a benefit but not essential
  • Familiarity with clinical development standards and regulatory requirements (GCP, FDA)
  • Knowledge of current industry standards (e.g., GCP, ICH, CDISC/CDASH)
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word); strong Excel skills required
  • Experience working in cross-functional, multi-site clinical trial teams

If you are looking to further your career in a pioneering and evolving industry, apply today for our Clinical Trial Associate position. We value and appreciate our employees and will support you with great company culture, opportunities for professional growth, competitive wages, and benefits. To learn more about us, visit us online at .

raw.description:
About the Client

We're helping a growing AI and process automation consultancy based in Munich, Germany find a Senior AI Automation Engineer to design and deliver sophisticated automation and AI-powered business solutions.

The company works with small and medium-sized businesses across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, helping them streamline operations, improve efficiency, and scale through intelligent automation. Its solutions span CRM systems, AI agents, automated workflows, business intelligence, and custom software integrations.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior AI Automation Engineer who combines a strong software development background with advanced hands-on experience in automation engineering and AI integrations.

You'll design and build complex automation systems, integrate AI technologies, develop custom code, and create tailored software solutions when existing platforms aren't sufficient.

Working closely with the founder and delivery team, you'll take ownership of projects from requirements gathering and technical design through development, deployment, and optimization.

This isn't a role for someone who only builds simple automations. We're looking for a software engineer who understands system architecture, can solve complex technical challenges, and knows when to use low-code platforms versus custom development.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)
Working Hours: CET
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Monthly Rate: $1,800-$2,400 (can be higher, depending on level of experience)

What You'll Do

AI Automation & Workflow Development

  • Design, build, and maintain complex automation workflows using n8n, Make.com, and Zapier.

  • Develop end-to-end integrations connecting business applications, APIs, databases, CRMs, and AI models.

  • Build and optimize HubSpot CRM automations, including contacts, deals, pipelines, properties, and workflows.

  • Develop AI-powered solutions and agents for sales, research, customer support, and other business processes.

  • Troubleshoot and optimize workflows for reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

Software Development & AI Systems

  • Develop custom integrations, scripts, and applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python.

  • Design robust system architectures involving APIs, webhooks, databases, and authentication.

  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems using LLMs, embeddings, document retrieval, and vector databases.

  • Evaluate existing platforms and develop custom solutions when off-the-shelf tools are insufficient.

  • Apply software engineering and cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure, reliable, and maintainable systems.

Project Ownership & Collaboration

  • Take ownership of projects from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, deployment, and optimization.

  • Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Collaborate with the founder and delivery team on technical decisions and project execution.

  • Maintain clear documentation and high standards of quality.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve systems, workflows, and development processes.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Several years (at least 3+) of professional software development experience, complemented by substantial hands-on automation engineering experience.

  • Advanced proficiency in n8n and Make.com, including complex, multi-step workflows and integrations.

  • Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot CRM, including its data structures, pipelines, properties, and automation capabilities.

  • Practical experience building RAG-based AI systems, including LLM integrations, embeddings, document retrieval, and vector databases.

  • Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python.

  • Solid understanding of APIs, webhooks, databases, authentication, and system architecture.

  • Experience developing AI-powered workflows, LLM integrations, and AI agents.

  • Ability to independently design, troubleshoot, and deliver complex technical solutions.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with Zapier, Close CRM, or other automation and CRM platforms.

  • Familiarity with Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development tools.

  • Experience building custom business applications or replacing/extending SaaS platforms.

  • Background in an AI automation consultancy, agency, or client-facing technical environment.

  • Previous technical leadership experience.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You're a software engineer at heart who understands both traditional development and modern automation platforms. You know when to use n8n or Make.com, when custom code is necessary, and how to design solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable.

You're analytical, structured, detail-oriented, and methodical in your approach. You think through technical challenges carefully, make logical and well-reasoned decisions, and value precision and quality over quick fixes.

You're also reliable, accountable, and calm under pressure. You take ownership of projects, communicate proactively, and can be trusted to deliver consistently high-quality work with minimal supervision.

Above all, you're curious about emerging AI technologies and motivated to build practical, innovative solutions that solve real business problems.

Why Join?

  • Work on complex AI automation, RAG, CRM integration, and custom software projects.

  • Collaborate closely with the founder of a growing AI consultancy serving the DACH market.

  • Take ownership of technical solutions with significant autonomy.

  • Help shape technical standards, processes, and future engineering capabilities.

  • Join a long-term, fully remote opportunity with room for professional growth.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview with Bamboo Works

  2. Client Interview

  3. Technical Assessment / Test Assignment

  4. Offer & Onboarding

The technical assessment will take place after the interview stage.

You will act as a trusted advisor and advocate, bridging the gap between users and our internal teams to foster strong relationships, drive adoption, and deliver exceptional experiences that align with our mission.

Massachusetts (Boston Area)

  • Issue Resolution: Identify and address issues, such as broken workflows or user challenges, by coordinating with internal teams to resolve them promptly.

  • Communication: Create and share regular updates, feature announcements, and instructional materials to keep users informed and engaged.

  • Feedback Collection: Gather feedback from administrators and officers through calls, surveys, and focus groups, using insights to guide product improvements and ensure department success.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple tasks and competing priorities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse audiences.

  • Able to quantitatively analyze user data and customer trends and draw insightful conclusions and translate them into actionable engagement plans.

  • Familiarity with tools like Amplitude, Slack, Wix, and Loom, or demonstrated ability to learn new tools quickly.

  • Experience working in early-stage startups and thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Strong understanding of customer success best practices, including onboarding, retention, and engagement strategies.

  • Experience coordinating with engineering and product teams for feature tracking and implementation.

  • Familiarity with email marketing tools and crafting clear, engaging user communications.

  • Customer-Centric: Passionate about helping customers succeed, with a solution-oriented mindset.

SERHANT. revolutionizes the traditional brokerage model by innovating through media and content creation and is powered by a full-service in-house film studio as well as an amplification platform that puts our properties in front of more people than anyone else.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who thrives across the stack and refuses to be boxed in. You move fluidly between frameworks - Next.js to Hono APIs to SvelteKit to Postgres - without friction or hand-holding. AI tools are part of your daily toolkit, and you write specs that make implementation straightforward.

Our Stack

  • Web Frameworks: SvelteKit, Next.js
  • APIs: Hono
  • Mobile: Expo (React Native)
  • Primary Database: Postgres
  • Analytics Database: ClickHouse

  • Move seamlessly between Next.js, SvelteKit, and Hono depending on what the problem requires

raw.title: Category Growth Manager, Women's Hormones
raw.excerpt: About AgelessRx AgelessRx is a first-of-its-kind, longevity-focused telehealth platform with an e-commerce component.
raw.description:
About AgelessRx

AgelessRx is a first-of-its-kind, longevity-focused telehealth platform with an e-commerce component. Our mission is to collectively give people millions of extra healthy years, so everyone can enjoy more of what they love in a world where people are empowered to live as long as they want. We believe aging should no longer be treated as a dreadful inevitability, but instead, as a puzzle that can be solved, a fight that can be fought – just as a disease with a cure. Through our free-to-use platform, we offer trusted, data-driven longevity solutions and scientifically backed prescription therapies to help safely lower the risk of age-related diseases.

About the role
AgelessRx is seeking a Category Growth Manager to own the strategy, growth, and commercial performance of key telehealth and longevity categories.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who can operate like a category owner: deeply understand the customer and market, identify where the biggest opportunities exist, develop a clear point of view on how AgelessRx should compete and differentiate, and bring together the right teams to turn those insights into measurable growth.

You will develop a deep understanding of your category - from the competitive landscape and customer needs to positioning, pricing, acquisition, conversion, retention, product experience, and unit economics. You will continuously talk to customers, study the market, evaluate the patient journey, analyze performance, and identify what needs to improve.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial judgment, customer obsession, analytical rigor, product thinking, and hands-on execution. You should be equally comfortable interviewing customers, analyzing a funnel, developing positioning, evaluating pricing or packaging, building a business case, launching an experiment, and driving a cross-functional initiative from idea through execution.

This role is intentionally broad. We want someone with high agency who can create structure where it does not yet exist, move quickly from insight to action, and become the internal owner and expert for their category.

What you'll do

Category Strategy & Commercial Performance

  • Own the strategy and growth of Women’s Hormones, including clear goals, priorities, performance metrics, and growth plans.
  • Develop a category strategy informed by market opportunity, customer needs, competitive dynamics, clinical considerations, and AgelessRx's broader business strategy.
  • Build a deep understanding of category performance and economics, including revenue, conversion, activation, CAC, LTV, retention, margin, payback, and ROI.
  • Identify the biggest opportunities and constraints to growth and translate them into clear priorities and recommendations.
  • Evaluate opportunities across pricing, packaging, offers, bundling, positioning, customer segments, and the broader category business model.
  • Build business cases and make recommendations about where AgelessRx should invest, test, expand, or change direction.

Customer, Market & Competitive Insight

  • Become the internal expert on the category, customer, and competitive landscape.
  • Build an ongoing customer feedback loop through interviews, user testing, surveys, behavioral data, Customer Experience insights, and other qualitative and quantitative research.
  • Develop a deep understanding of what customers need, how they make decisions, why they choose AgelessRx or a competitor, and where their experience falls short.
  • Continuously evaluate competitors, including their positioning, products, pricing, customer experience, strengths, weaknesses, and emerging strategies.
  • Identify unmet customer needs and market gaps that can become differentiated AgelessRx offerings.
  • Translate customer and market insights into actionable recommendations for Marketing, Product, Clinical, and Operations.

Offering & Customer Journey

  • Own the category experience across the customer journey - from initial discovery and education through conversion, onboarding, treatment, engagement, and retention.
  • Identify friction points and opportunities to improve both customer value and business performance.
  • Develop hypotheses about what AgelessRx should build, change, test, or stop doing.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Operations to translate customer and market needs into product and service improvements.
  • Help prioritize category-specific features and capabilities based on customer and commercial impact.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the category through new treatments, services, bundles, cross-sell opportunities, and adjacent offerings.
  • Ensure the category delivers a compelling and differentiated experience rather than simply replicating what already exists in the market.

Go-to-Market & Growth

  • Own the go-to-market strategy for new category offerings.
  • Define target audiences, positioning, value propositions, messaging, launch priorities, channel opportunities, and success metrics.
  • Partner with Growth, Brand, Lifecycle, Content, Creative, Product, Clinical, and Compliance teams to bring category strategies to market.
  • Develop and prioritize experiments across acquisition, landing pages, onboarding, conversion, pricing, offers, messaging, lifecycle, retention, and re-engagement.
  • Analyze performance quickly, understand what is driving results, and translate learnings into the next round of decisions and experiments.
  • Identify new channels, partnerships, community opportunities, and other ways to efficiently reach and engage target customers.
  • Ensure growth is sustainable and economically sound rather than focused solely on top-line acquisition.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience across category management, growth, product marketing, general management, business strategy, consumer product, or a related commercially focused role.
  • Experience owning meaningful growth or commercial outcomes for a digital product, consumer health business, telehealth service, subscription business, marketplace, or category-level business line.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand a market and translate customer, competitive, and performance insights into business strategy and execution.
  • Strong commercial and analytical skills, with experience working with metrics such as revenue, conversion, CAC, LTV, retention, activation, margin, payback, and ROI.
  • Experience building, launching, or scaling products, services, categories, or business lines in an ambiguous or rapidly changing environment.
  • Strong customer research instincts and comfort directly interviewing customers, evaluating customer behavior, and translating insights into action.
  • Experience with positioning, value propositions, pricing, packaging, offers, go-to-market strategy, or new product/service launches.
  • Comfort operating in a regulated environment where growth must be balanced with clinical accuracy, privacy, compliance, patient trust, and responsible communication.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; familiarity with GA4, Looker, SQL, CRM/lifecycle platforms, or product analytics tools is a plus.
  • Experience in telehealth, digital health, consumer health, women's health, or another regulated consumer category is strongly preferred; genuine curiosity about longevity, preventative health, and the future of healthcare.

raw.description:
Thread Recruitment is proud to support Straightcurve in finding its Head of Strategy & Global Expansion. You’ll work alongside the founder as a strategic partner, own the group’s commercial performance, and turn ambitious ideas into clear decisions and results.

Straightcurve is a design-led landscape products business already selling in seven countries. Its products are proven, and its automated systems are designed to scale.

Now it’s looking to strengthen the markets it’s already in and build the ones that come next, starting with the USA.

Plenty of people can talk strategy. Very few can make it work. If you’re one of them, keep reading.

What You’ll Be Doing

This is strategy with its sleeves rolled up. You’ll work closely with Straightcurve’s founder to decide what deserves attention and turn the right opportunities into plans the team can deliver.

You’ll integrate the work across sales, operations, marketing and international markets. Strong leaders run each area independently; you’ll set direction with them, connect their work and keep the business moving in the same direction.

What that looks like in practice:

  • Owning the group P&L and overseeing cash flow across the business

  • Building the commercial case and action plan for new ideas, including the numbers, risks, people and practical steps needed to deliver

  • Leading Straightcurve’s expansion into the USA

  • Growing the UK business

  • Scaling Australia, the engine of the business, while improving its profitability

  • Spotting and validating the next market opportunity

  • Deciding what to pursue now and what can wait, so the business stays focused

  • Building the systems and structure that let each market run itself

The role is remote, but it isn’t hands-off. Expect to travel across Australia and overseas a few times a year, spending time on the ground with the people and the work that make Straightcurve run.

Who You Are

You’re a builder with a numbers brain. You’ve owned a P&L, you can read a balance sheet, and you’ve taken something from an idea to a trading business. You’d rather get on the ground and understand a market than theorise about it from a boardroom.

You’re calm under pressure and restless for what’s next. A good idea gets you moving; the numbers keep you honest. You challenge with evidence rather than ego, see the risks and find a way around them, and bring a team-first mindset to everything you do.

You’ll bring:

  • Fluency with P&Ls, balance sheets, budgets and cash flow

  • Proof you’ve built or scaled something: a business, a market or a team

  • A systems mind: you see how the pieces connect and build structure that lasts

  • The ability to lead strong, independent people without micromanaging them

  • Comfort with ambiguity, backed by the judgement to know when to push and when to pause

  • Curiosity about the world, and a drive to always find ways to make things better

  • Permanent Australian work rights

Why Join Straightcurve?

Straightcurve is more than it looks. From the outside, it’s a landscape edging business with a serious commitment to sustainability. Inside, it’s a team that’s genuinely passionate about what they do, in a business built to put heart back into work. The people here care about building something bigger than themselves.

You can expect:

  • A seat alongside the founder, with ownership of the numbers and the growth

  • A direct impact on how the business grows

  • Flexibility and autonomy of remote work, with time on the ground where it counts

  • Freedom to make decisions, with accountability for what follows

  • A team that works closely together and genuinely has each other’s back

  • Room for the role to grow with the business

  • A competitive salary plus super

Apply Now

You’ve built something before. This time, the foundations are already in place, and the opportunity is much bigger.

Send us your CV and a thoughtful cover letter or reach out to for a confidential conversation.

We are seeking an experienced Windchill Java Developer focused on deep, low-level Windchill customizations using Java, PTC APIs, and PTC’s customization frameworks.   • Ten or more years of Java development experience, with strong focus on Windchill customization.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with the Windchill Java API and customization frameworks.

About the role

The Campaign Manager (Performance Analyst) is responsible for the implementation, monitoring, and optimization of digital campaigns across platforms, ensuring accuracy in execution, data integrity, and performance delivery.

As part of the performance hub, this role supports campaign delivery across multiple accounts, executing against defined strategies and adhering to established standards, processes, and playbooks.

The Campaign Manager focuses on execution excellence, working under the guidance of the Supervisor of Performance, and plays a critical role in ensuring campaigns are launched, managed, and optimized with precision.

What you'll do

Campaign Implementation

Budget & Pacing Control

Reporting & Insights

  • Build and maintain campaign performance reports and dashboards.

Operational Support

Cross-Team Collaboration

Follow guidance from the Supervisor on optimization, technical setup, and troubleshooting.

Qualifications

Description

About Factify

AI agents are starting to make decisions in regulated enterprises, including US banks and insurers. Factify turns an organization’s policies, documents and real-world practice into a sealed, executable rulebook that governs how those agents decide. Every decision is traceable, auditable and ratified by the people who own the process.

The role

You will be our finance expert. You will map how the finance function runs at large US-regulated enterprises, including approvals, controls, exceptions and close activities, and define the rules that let AI agents operate inside it without breaking controls.

What you’ll do

  • Map core finance processes: record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, period close and consolidation, treasury, expense management and FP&A.
  • Document approval matrices, delegation-of-authority rules, segregation-of-duties constraints and internal controls (SOX / ICFR).
  • Analyze finance policies, accounting manuals and audit findings. Identify where documented policy and day-to-day practice differ.
  • Define decision rules for tasks such as invoice matching, accrual and reconciliation thresholds, spend approvals and journal-entry validation.
  • Build test cases and golden-label datasets with documented evidence, and review agent behavior against them.
  • Partner with CFOs, controllers and internal audit to ratify the rulebook and keep it current.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in finance leadership, controllership, finance transformation, internal audit or a Big 4 finance advisory practice.
  • Hands-on US GAAP and SOX 404 / ICFR (COSO) experience at a US-listed company. This includes Israeli companies listed in the US.
  • Experience with ERP-driven finance operations (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite or similar).
  • Experience mapping and redesigning finance processes, with credibility with senior finance stakeholders.
  • The ability to turn policy and judgment into explicit conditions, thresholds and exceptions.
  • Fluent English, with clear written and verbal communication with CFOs, auditors and engineers.
  • Location: Remote (US), with regular overlap with our Tel Aviv team (US Eastern morning hours).

Nice to have

  • Experience with finance automation, shared services or an RPA / AI program in the finance function.
  • CPA, CMA, CIA or equivalent credentials.
  • IFRS exposure.

A leading organization is seeking a Senior Security Analyst to support and strengthen its information security function. This role is responsible for protecting systems, ensuring regulatory compliance, managing security risks, and supporting incident response activities across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Information Security Management

  • Perform regular security assessments and vulnerability scans to identify risks across systems and infrastructure
  • Implement and maintain controls to safeguard systems, data, and networks from unauthorized access and threats
  • Monitor security alerts and logs, investigate anomalies, and respond to incidents in a timely manner
  • Support the development and enforcement of internal security policies, standards, and procedures
  • Partner with technology teams to ensure secure system configurations and deployments
  • Stay informed on emerging threats, tools, and best practices to continuously enhance security capabilities


Compliance & Regulatory Support

  • Ensure alignment with applicable security standards, regulations, and contractual obligations (e.g., data privacy and industry frameworks)
  • Conduct internal assessments and audits to validate compliance
  • Prepare documentation and reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to interpret regulatory requirements and implement necessary controls
  • Provide guidance on compliance matters and support remediation efforts


Risk Management

  • Identify and evaluate security risks based on likelihood and potential impact

  • Recommend and implement mitigation strategies to reduce exposure

  • Work closely with business units to integrate security practices into operational processes


Security Awareness & Training

  • Deliver security awareness sessions to promote a culture of security across the organization
  • Educate employees on policies, procedures, and best practices to minimize human-related risks


Testing, Incident Response & Forensics

  • Conduct testing of applications and environments to identify vulnerabilities and emerging threats
  • Participate in incident response activities, including investigation and resolution
  • Assist with evidence collection, forensic analysis, and incident reporting


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Proven experience in information security, compliance, or a related discipline
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISA, CISM) are advantageous
  • Strong understanding of security frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, CIS)

  • Experience in risk assessment and risk management methodologies

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams


Technical Skills & Tools

  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS and Azure)

  • Familiarity with system hardening practices across endpoints and infrastructure

  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (e.g., Bash)
  • Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Kubernetes)
  • Understanding of encryption methods and authentication technologies
  • Familiarity with internet protocols and data formats (e.g., HTTP, TLS, XML)
  • Experience with database technologies (e.g., SQL-based systems, Elasticsearch)

Preferred Qualifications

raw.excerpt: Company Overview At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents.
raw.description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a full-time, flexible work from home position and can be located anywhere in the U.S.

Compact RN License Required

Perks: Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands-on workers’ compensation case management training.

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Telephonic Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:

  • Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
  • Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
  • Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non-occupational.
  • Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
  • Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
  • Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
  • Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
  • Complete other duties, such as prepare status updates for submittal to customers, assist in training/orientation of new staff as requested, and other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Education: Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
  • Experience: 2+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation-related experience preferred.
  • Skills: Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
  • Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:
    • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
    • URAC-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN-S, RN-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
  • Internet: Must have reliable internet.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from$80,000 - $86,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

raw.description:
Keep every account accurate, compliant, and ready for what’s next. We’re looking for a dependable AU Intermediate Bookkeeper who can turn day-to-day transactions into clean, reliable financial records. If you enjoy balancing detail, deadlines, and proactive client support, this role is built for you.

Work Setup:Work From Home

Role Overview

As our AU Intermediate Bookkeeper, you’ll maintain accurate accounting records for Australian small business clients across transaction processing, reconciliations, payroll, accounts payable and receivable, and compliance support. You’ll keep source documents organised, help prepare BAS and IAS requirements, and proactively flag risks so client accounts remain accurate, timely, and well controlled.

Key Responsibilities

  • Record Every Transaction: Enter and categorise income, expenses, and other transactions accurately in Xero.

  • Keep Documents Organised: Collect, review, upload, and attach invoices, receipts, statements, and supporting records to the correct transactions.

  • Manage Payables and Receivables: Process accounts payable and accounts receivable accurately and within agreed timelines.

  • Process Payroll: Prepare Australian payroll, complete STP lodgements, and support Superannuation Guarantee payment processing in line with relevant requirements.

  • Reconcile Accounts: Reconcile bank, credit card, and loan accounts weekly, investigating and resolving discrepancies promptly.

  • Support Compliance: Assist with BAS and IAS preparation and maintain accurate records for review and lodgement.

  • Help Close the Books: Support month-end and year-end activities, schedules, checks, and follow-ups as required.

  • Spot Risks Early: Identify potential issues from bookkeeping checks, raise them proactively, recommend practical actions, and support other priorities assigned by the Team Manager or Service Delivery Manager.

Skills & Experience

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

  • At least 3 years of Australian bookkeeping experience, supported by a solid general accounting background.

  • Working knowledge of Australian GST, payroll, STP lodgement, and Superannuation Guarantee requirements.

  • Hands-on experience with Xero and familiarity with MYOB, QuickBooks, Hubdoc, Karbon, or similar accounting tools.

  • Confident using Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work with minimal supervision.

  • Effective time management, organisation, and prioritisation skills across multiple client tasks and deadlines.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, supported by practical critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • CPA qualification is highly regarded.

What’s in It for You

  • Flexibility that Fits: Hybrid options across Makati and Pampanga, on day shifts aligned with our Australian clients.

  • Workspaces that Work: Modern offices built for focus, collaboration, and real productivity.

  • Coffee and Good Company: Barista coffee on demand and a café bar to unwind after work.

  • Meals on Us: Complimentary meals once a week on your on-site day.

  • Covered from Day One: Health coverage with free dependent coverage, so you're looked after from the start.

  • Compensation You Can See: Transparent salary packages with direct client involvement.

  • Room to Grow: Ongoing training and real opportunities to step into bigger roles.

  • An Award-Winning Home: Join a team ranked 8th Best Workplace in the Philippines and recognised among Fortune Best Workplaces in Southeast Asia.

  • People Who Have Your Back: Work alongside reliable, easy-going people who care about doing great work.

  • A Global Stage: Work directly with international clients and see how teams scale worldwide.

About Us
At hammerjack, we connect skilled professionals in the Philippines with growing businesses across Australia and beyond—building teams that work as true extensions of our clients. We're proud to be named among the Fortune 100 Best Workplaces in Southeast Asia and ranked the 8th Best Workplace in the Philippines.

Our Impact
Our people aren't outsourced—they're embedded. With aligned tools, shared goals, and real accountability, they deliver at the same standard and pace as onshore teams while building long-term careers they're proud of, across accounting, tech, admin, and marketing.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

*MUST BE HANDS ON WITH BLOCKCHAIN*

Under the direction of the Executive Director of Global Public Relations, this person will serve as a senior member of the team, with responsibility for strategising, developing and executing a robust media strategy aligned to business goals and objectives.

In doing so, the Director, Public Relations will promote company news, information and thought leadership to the media and analyst community, proactively build and manage relationships with editors, journalists and analysts, influence news coverage, shape perceptions of the firm and protect against reputational risk.

By partnering closely with members of the M&C team, business heads and senior leaders within the company, they will develop compelling messaging and content, leverage media trends to attain positive news coverage and generate story ideas, and draft and place bylined articles to establish senior leaders as spokespeople and thought leaders and provide strategic counsel on PR opportunities across businesses.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Overall responsibility is to strategise, develop and execute a global public relations strategy across businesses and their related thought leadership areas, generating awareness and coverage via proactive pitching, interviews, bylines, media tours, statements, roundtables, editor briefings and more.
  • Collaborate with M&C peers to ensure a holistic M&C strategy and reporting, with defined goals, objectives and KPIs.
  • Leverage writing skills and knowledge of the industry, to develop media narratives through compelling thought leadership on key initiatives.
  • Manage overall engagement with the media in the US, responding to urgent enquiries across business topics, developing relationships across key Tier 1 and targeted trade media (including key reporters globally in DLT-related publications), and facilitating in-person meetings with journalists and key Executive Committee staff.
  • Maintain positive relationships with global PR agencies in the US and London, advising on strategy and work initiatives and reviewing/approving all quotes, content and coverage.
  • Monitor and read all coverage related to relevant topics and strategise around areas of opportunity including new areas of opportunity for the business.
  • Support social media activity for related media work, including content development, video initiatives and more.
  • Mitigates risk by following established procedures, spotting key errors and demonstrating strong ethical behaviour.

**NOTE: The responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

﻿

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum of 12-15 years of related experience
  • Hands-on with Blockchain
  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience
  • Communications degree, with a solid understanding of all communications disciplines,
  • Strong verbal and writing capabilities, with the ability to translate complex business topics into higher-level themes that will resonate with journalists and readers; Leverage compelling storytelling and data-driven content
  • Ability to network and influence colleagues on PR recommendations and strategies
  • Solid analytical capabilities, to measure results and identify areas of opportunity
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, in order to effectively prioritise a number of simultaneous projects while sometimes meeting short deadlines

BENEFITS:

  • Base salary of £95-125k (dependent on experience and qualifications)
  • Bonus
  • Pension
  • Paternity/Maternity/Bereavement leave
