Healthcare Software Implementation Specialist – 100% Remote

At RAM Health, our mission is to simplify the complexities of healthcare administration through innovative, technology-driven solutions. With a focus on changing the industry one plan at a time, we drive continuous innovation to help government-sponsored health plans improve performance and quality while reducing costs.

RAM Health - Health plan administration, simplified.

This position is 100% remote and allows you to live anywhere in the U.S. and work from your home office. RAM does not provide sponsorship for U.S. employment and candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. All work must be done within the U.S.

Working as part of the Client Support team, the Implementation Specialist has the ability to forge strong customer relations, evaluate client requirements and develop configurations that support business processes.

Responsibilities of an Implementation Specialist:

  • Define and execute implementation plans.
  • Test and troubleshoot final system configuration.
  • Provide training and end-user support during and after the implementation process.
  • May be involved in pre-sales product demonstrations.
  • Analyze client data to assist clients with configuration issues.
  • Create and run database queries to evaluate data.
  • Configure and test within the system to make recommendations to clients.
  • Identify and facilitate issue resolution with functional and technical groups.

Requirements of an Implementation Specialist:

  • Strong reading comprehension, writing and presentation skills.
  • 2-4 years of related health care or software implementation experience.
  • Bachelor's degree with a focus in Management Information Systems or Health Care is preferred or equivalent experience is required.
  • Knowledge of the healthcare industry and/or working experience with technology (i.e. UNIX, SQL, etc.) is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Occasional travel may be required in the future.

The Implementation Specialist offers a salary range of $80,000 to $90,000 commensurate with experience and an excellent benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, life insurance, STD, LTD, 5 weeks' vacation, and paid holidays.

Compliance: All employees shall comply with company policies, including those related to security and privacy, as well as with applicable laws and regulations such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), the Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health (HITECH) Act, and other relevant federal and state regulations.

Data Protection: Employees are responsible for safeguarding protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII) in accordance with company policies and HIPAA regulations. This includes ensuring that all data is accessed, processed, stored, and transmitted securely.

Note: This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the position and is not an exhaustive list of efforts, duties, responsibilities, or working conditions associated with it. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Salary: $80,000 - $90,000

raw.description:
Role Overview

A leading organization is seeking a Senior Security Analyst to support and strengthen its information security function. This role is responsible for protecting systems, ensuring regulatory compliance, managing security risks, and supporting incident response activities across the organization.

The position requires a strong blend of technical expertise, risk awareness, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to maintain a robust security posture.

Key Responsibilities

Information Security Management

  • Perform regular security assessments and vulnerability scans to identify risks across systems and infrastructure
  • Implement and maintain controls to safeguard systems, data, and networks from unauthorized access and threats
  • Monitor security alerts and logs, investigate anomalies, and respond to incidents in a timely manner
  • Support the development and enforcement of internal security policies, standards, and procedures
  • Partner with technology teams to ensure secure system configurations and deployments
  • Stay informed on emerging threats, tools, and best practices to continuously enhance security capabilities


Compliance & Regulatory Support

  • Ensure alignment with applicable security standards, regulations, and contractual obligations (e.g., data privacy and industry frameworks)
  • Conduct internal assessments and audits to validate compliance
  • Prepare documentation and reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to interpret regulatory requirements and implement necessary controls
  • Provide guidance on compliance matters and support remediation efforts


Risk Management

  • Identify and evaluate security risks based on likelihood and potential impact

  • Recommend and implement mitigation strategies to reduce exposure

  • Work closely with business units to integrate security practices into operational processes


Security Awareness & Training

  • Deliver security awareness sessions to promote a culture of security across the organization
  • Educate employees on policies, procedures, and best practices to minimize human-related risks


Testing, Incident Response & Forensics

  • Conduct testing of applications and environments to identify vulnerabilities and emerging threats
  • Participate in incident response activities, including investigation and resolution
  • Assist with evidence collection, forensic analysis, and incident reporting


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Proven experience in information security, compliance, or a related discipline
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISA, CISM) are advantageous
  • Strong understanding of security frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, CIS)
  • Familiarity with global data protection and privacy regulations
  • Experience in risk assessment and risk management methodologies
  • Hands-on experience with security tools such as firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and SIEM platform
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams


Technical Skills & Tools

  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS and Azure)
  • Knowledge of network security technologies (firewalls, WAFs, VPNs, load balancers)
  • Familiarity with system hardening practices across endpoints and infrastructure
  • Experience with penetration testing and vulnerability assessment tools
  • Understanding of malware, attack vectors, and incident response processes
  • Knowledge of distributed systems and enterprise network environments
  • Experience with intrusion prevention systems and endpoint security
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (e.g., Bash)
  • Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Kubernetes)
  • Understanding of encryption methods and authentication technologies
  • Familiarity with internet protocols and data formats (e.g., HTTP, TLS, XML)
  • Experience with database technologies (e.g., SQL-based systems, Elasticsearch)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in highly regulated environments (e.g., government or similar sectors)
  • Exposure to handling sensitive or classified information
  • Knowledge of additional regulatory standards and frameworks
  • Additional certifications in security, penetration testing, or offensive security are a plus

Role Overview

By partnering closely with members of the M&C team, business heads and senior leaders within the company, they will develop compelling messaging and content, leverage media trends to attain positive news coverage and generate story ideas, and draft and place bylined articles to establish senior leaders as spokespeople and thought leaders and provide strategic counsel on PR opportunities across businesses.

  • Maintain positive relationships with global PR agencies in the US and London, advising on strategy and work initiatives and reviewing/approving all quotes, content and coverage.
  • Monitor and read all coverage related to relevant topics and strategise around areas of opportunity including new areas of opportunity for the business.
  • Support social media activity for related media work, including content development, video initiatives and more.

﻿

  • Base salary of £95-125k (dependent on experience and qualifications)

Goldbelt Professional Services specializes in providing expert resources for Public Health missions including scientific, technical, and administrative support from junior staff to high-level subject matter experts. Research and data driven, Goldbelt Professional Services’ experts create solutions customized to the client’s needs.

Summary:

Goldbelt Professional Services is seeking an Epidemiologist IV to provide epidemiological support for the International Infection Control Program (IICB).

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Collaborate with CDC staff at headquarters and overseas offices to monitor infection prevention, control, and surveillance activities to prevent the spread of antimicrobial resistance and/or novel Coronavirus in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Develop guidance, training materials, and monitoring/evaluation tools; provide training, technical assistance, and user support to Ministries of Health and health facilities.
  • Develop strategies to improve data collection, analysis, and use for combatting antimicrobial resistance and novel viruses.
  • Develop internal and external communication products on antimicrobial resistance and novel viruses.
  • Develop and prepare data summaries, feedback reports, and presentations for partners.
  • Participate in calls and in-person meetings with internal and external partners.
  • Provide recommendations for data-driven action using critical thinking and decision-making.
  • Develop and implement work plans with DHQP SMEs and partners to accomplish surveillance and program goals.
  • Travel to healthcare facilities or other sites to support infection prevention and surveillance activities.
  • Participate during CDC response activities and training exercises under direction of the DHQP Team Lead; duties include staffing the EOC desk to help support CDC's mission.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Ability to independently develop analytic approaches and evaluate the validity and limitations of epidemiologic findings.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects and work independently with limited supervision.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical findings to nontechnical audiences and senior leadership.
  • Ability to communicate with multidisciplinary teams, community partners, healthcare organizations, governmental agencies, or other stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of public health surveillance, disease investigation, data quality, confidentiality, and applicable public-health policies and regulations

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years providing epidemiological expertise in a professional setting.
  • Professional working knowledge of R and/or Python is required.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, conducting, and interpreting epidemiologic studies and investigations.
  • Advanced knowledge of epidemiologic methods, study design, statistical analysis, and data interpretation.
  • Experience working with large, complex, or multiple data sources, including administrative, surveillance, clinical, or population-health data.
  • Experience translating complex epidemiologic findings into clear reports, presentations, recommendations, and actionable conclusions.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain CDC Public Trust Clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Doctoral degree (PhD, DrPH, ScD, or equivalent) in epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years providing epidemiological expertise in a professional setting.
  • Prior experience working with the CDC is highly desired to understand the culture and environment

Pay and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $120,000 to $130,000 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Workday HCM Solution Lead (T5)

Operating within the IT HCM portfolio, the Workday Human Capital Management (HCM) Solution Lead serves as the senior solution advisor for the Workday HCM platform, combining deep technical expertise with a holistic understanding of how Workday capabilities, business processes, data, and integrations come together to create the best experience for users. The role develops recommendations and guides architecture, data stewardship, governance, roadmap execution, risk management, operational health, and the responsible adoption of AI, automation, and emerging Workday capabilities in alignment with the direction and priorities established by IT HCM Portfolio Leadership. The role understands the people and organizational impacts of the platform and designs solutions with those impacts in mind. The role partners with IT HCM and Finance Portfolio Leadership, the Workday Finance Solution Lead, HR stakeholders, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Data and Analytics, delivery teams, and strategic partners to align HCM standards and execution with shared capabilities across the broader Workday ecosystem.

What You Will Do

HCM Platform Strategy, Architecture & Data

  • Develop and recommend the Workday HCM technical strategy, architecture, operating model, and standards for approval by IT HCM Portfolio Leadership, and advise on Workday HCM priorities for inclusion in the 18-month portfolio roadmap.
  • Apply deep Workday HCM expertise to evaluate platform capabilities, constraints, technical tradeoffs, and emerging functionality.
  • Establish Workday HCM architecture and platform standards across configuration, integrations, extensions, security, data, reporting, downstream consumption, and solution design, ensuring these components work together cohesively to support intuitive, effective user experiences, while providing technology stewardship for Workday HCM data integrity and access in partnership with business Data Owners and enterprise Data Governance.
  • Ensure solutions comply with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, change management, and technology standards.

Enterprise Workday & Financials Alignment

  • Partner with the Workday Financials (FIN) Solution Lead to align architecture, technology standards, integration patterns, security guardrails, environments, releases, and governance practices across Workday HCM, Financials, and shared capabilities.
  • Coordinate cross-platform dependencies and decisions affecting HCM, Financials, integrations, data, security, reporting, and shared capabilities.
  • Lead HCM architecture decisions for shared Workday capabilities and coordinate with the Workday Finance Solution Lead and enterprise teams on decisions that affect their areas.
  • Escalate unresolved cross-platform issues, decision conflicts, and risks to IT Portfolio Leadership for direction and resolution.

AI, Agents & Emerging Technology

  • Define the Workday HCM architecture, technical approach, and HCM-specific guardrails for AI, Agents, automation, Workday Extend, and emerging capabilities in alignment with enterprise AI, security, data, and architecture standards.
  • Co-govern Workday Extend with the Workday Finance Solution Lead, including shared modules, architecture standards, development practices, security, release coordination, and ownership of cross-functional capabilities.
  • Partner with IT Portfolio Leadership to identify opportunities while promoting reusable enterprise patterns and standards.
  • Evaluate Workday-native and enterprise capabilities for alignment with the Workday HCM architecture, broader Workday ecosystem, and enterprise technology strategy.

Roadmap Execution & Delivery

  • Evaluate approved Workday HCM roadmap items in partnership with the IT HCM Portfolio Lead, jointly assign work with the HCM Delivery Lead, and provide technical guidance while the HCM Delivery Lead oversees execution through completion.
  • Support portfolio demand and prioritization governance by assessing Workday HCM feasibility, dependencies, risks, effort, and technical sequencing.
  • Provide oversight of major Workday HCM initiatives, ensuring solution decisions account for user experience, business process, change, adoption, and broader people and organizational impacts, while empowering functional, technical, integration, analytics, and support leaders to manage execution.
  • Establish measures for Workday HCM platform health, delivery effectiveness, operational performance, and roadmap execution.
  • Provide Workday HCM technical recommendations to IT Portfolio Leadership regarding investment needs, resources, risks, dependencies, vendor performance, and strategic opportunities.

Governance, Risk & Controls

  • Establish and oversee technology governance and clear decision rights for Workday HCM solution design, security, integrations, data, releases, environments, changes, and production operations across HR, Finance, IT, Security, Architecture, Data and Analytics, delivery teams, and external partners.
  • Oversee Workday HCM platform technology risk, technical debt, architectural complexity, and lifecycle risks.
  • Ensure appropriate controls, documentation, and governance practices support audit readiness, regulatory requirements, and operational continuity.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor’s degree plus 8+ years of relevant experience, or 12+ years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Deep Workday HCM expertise across platform capabilities, configuration, integrations, security, architecture, and operational considerations.
  • Experience serving as a platform solution lead or senior technical lead accountable for platform strategy and delivery outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of how Workday HCM architecture, lifecycle management, integrations, security, data, business processes, change management, and operational support fit together across the broader Workday ecosystem, with demonstrated ability to design for user experience and the people and organizational impacts of the system.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess complex technology decisions and communicate recommendations, risks, investment needs, and tradeoffs to senior and executive leadership.
  • Experience leading cross-functional work involving IT Delivery, Architecture, Security, Data, business stakeholders, vendors, and implementation partners.

What Would Be Nice To Have

  • Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced Workday certifications (e.g., Workday Pro – HCM Core, Absence, Talent & Performance, Advanced Compensation, Recruiting).

  • Experience with people analytics, reporting platforms, or data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
  • Demonstrated progression toward senior technical authority roles (e.g., Principal Platform Lead, Lead Architect, Distinguished Technologist).
The annual salary range for this position is $135,000.00-$225,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

About RAB2B

RAB2B is a global B2B marketing agency that partners with ambitious brands to drive measurable growth. We combine strategic thinking, media excellence, and operational rigor to deliver integrated solutions across markets. Our culture is built on accountability, clarity, and performance, empowering our teams to lead with ownership while collaborating across disciplines.

About the role

The Media Planner is responsible for the development, execution, and optimization of media plans across digital channels. This role ensures campaigns are strategically aligned with client objectives and executed with operational excellence.

Working under the guidance of a Supervisor or Director, the Planner translates strategy into actionable plans, manages campaign performance, and contributes insights that improve campaign outcomes

What you'll do

Media Planning & Strategy Support

  • Develop media plans aligned with client objectives and strategic direction provided by senior leadership.
  • Define channel mix, audiences, formats, and investment distribution across platforms.
  • Conduct market, audience, and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and inform planning decisions.
  • Support the development of full-funnel media approaches spanning awareness, consideration, and conversion.

Campaign Execution & Optimization

  • Manage the implementation of media plans across digital platforms including social, search, video, and programmatic.
  • Monitor campaign performance and optimize based on KPIs, benchmarks, and performance insights.
  • Ensure correct pacing of budgets and delivery against planned investment levels.
  • Coordinate with activation, trading, or platform specialists to ensure correct campaign deployment.

Reporting & Insights

  • Prepare campaign performance reports and dashboards.
  • Analyze results and identify actionable insights for optimization.
  • Support post-campaign analyses and learning documentation.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with strategy, performance, analytics, and creative teams to ensure campaign alignment.
  • Support client presentations and planning sessions when required.

Maintain accurate documentation of campaign plans, budgets, and performance metrics.

Qualifications

  • 1–4 years of experience in media planning, digital marketing, or advertising agencies.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of the digital media ecosystem including:
    • Social platforms (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Pinterest)
    • Search marketing (Google Ads, Bing Ads, TikTok Search)
    • Video platforms (YouTube, Amazon, Netflix)
    • Display and Programmatic advertising
  • Familiarity with audience research tools such as TGI, GWI, or equivalent is a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel for data analysis and budget management.
  • PowerPoint or similar tools for presenting media plans.
  • Familiarity with media buying platforms and analytics dashboards.

Core Competencies

  • Analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Organization and ability to manage multiple campaigns
  • Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills

Curiosity about media innovation and emerging platforms

​​As a National Account Manager, you will be responsible for a specified channel. This role is uniquely positioned for an ambitious leader who is craving full ownership and accountability for our products and customers within the assigned Accounts. This is not a traditional sales role. We are searching for a candidate who shows a high level of ownership for their business and is adept at selling solutions and has a proven ability to win new business. Certified Professional Coder- Orthopedic
Job Summary:
The Certified Professional Coder performs various duties to accurately interpret and bill physician charges for physician services by entering into the appropriate CPT, ICD-10, and modifiers into the Billing system.

(This is a full-time hybrid or remote position that will support the RCM team, Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm- Coding certification required)

Primary Job Responsibilities/Tasks may include, but not limited to:
  • Performs initial charge review to determine appropriate ICD-10 and CPT codes to be used to report physician services to third party payers.
  • Interprets progress notes, operative reports, discharge summaries, and charge documents to determine services provided and accurately assign CPT and ICD-10 coding to these services, according to guidelines established by the AMA.
  • Enter appropriate data into the TMP billing system by selecting the appropriate codes, diagnosis, modifiers, to complete the charge process.
  • Adheres to department guidelines for timeliness of processing charges and communicates with team members and practice management on an ongoing basis to ensure these guidelines are met.
  • Contacts physicians through query protocols regarding procedures and other services billed to ensure proper coding.
  • Responsible for reviewing patient logs and other report of clinical activity to ensure billing is captured for all patients.
  • Reviews all physician documentation to ensure compliance with third party and regulatory guidelines.
  • Works in conjunction with the Reimbursement staff to answer all inquiries regarding coding and billing for TMP physicians' services.
  • Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

Requirements:

Education and Certifications:

  • High school diploma or GED completion is required.
  • A minimum of three (3) years’ experience with CPT and ICD-10 coding of physician services required.
  • Coding certification required. CPC Certification preferred. Must maintain active certification and required CEUs during employment tenure.
  • Advanced working knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, and physiology required.
  • Knowledge of and the ability to apply payer specific rules regarding coding, bundling, and adding appropriate modifiers.
  • Understanding of and familiarity with regulatory guidelines including NCDs and LCDs.

Experience:

  • Family Practice, Internal Medicine, Cardiology, Rheumatology, Endocrinology, Gynecology, and Dermatology preferred.
  • Knowledge of current third-party billing and collection regulatory guidelines and requirements.
  • Advanced knowledge of the ICD-10 CM/PCS and CPT/HCPCS coding systems and conventions.
  • Advanced knowledge of, but not limited to, Official Coding Guidelines and methodologies.
  • Knowledge of current third-party billing and collection regulatory guidelines and requirements.
  • Good interpersonal skills and a basic understanding of team concept.
  • Ability to gather and interpret clinical data.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Physical Requirements:

  • Work consistently requires walking, standing, sitting, lifting, reaching, stooping, bending, pushing, and pulling.
  • Must be able to lift and support weight of 35 pounds.
  • Ability to concentrate on details.
  • Use of computer for long periods of time.

Clinical Research Project Manager – Study Start-Up & Site Activation

Company: UniTriTeam (UTT)
Position: Clinical Research Project Manager – Study Start-Up
Department: Clinical Research Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote / Client-Specific Requirements

Position Overview

UniTriTeam is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and results-driven Clinical Research Project Managerto support one of our clinical research clients in managing the end-to-end study start-up process.

This individual will be responsible for coordinating cross-functional teams, managing timelines, tracking critical deliverables, and ensuring clinical research studies are activated on time, with all operational, regulatory, contractual, and system requirements in place.

The ideal candidate has a strong clinical research background, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and brings exceptional attention to detail, urgency, accountability, and follow-through.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just track progress—they drive it. This person must anticipate roadblocks, take initiative, hold stakeholders accountable, and ensure that nothing falls through the cracks.

This is a highly visible, hands-on role requiring strong project management skills, clinical research knowledge, and the ability to coordinate multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Study Start-Up & Site Activation
  • Own and manage the study start-up process from initial study award or feasibility through site activation and readiness for first patient enrollment.
  • Develop comprehensive study start-up plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables for each assigned study.
  • Coordinate start-up activities across regulatory, contracts, budgets, clinical operations, finance, recruitment, technology, and other functional teams.
  • Track all required study start-up activities, including feasibility, regulatory submissions, IRB approvals, contracts, budgets, training, system readiness, and sponsor requirements.
  • Ensure all study-specific documentation, approvals, and operational requirements are completed before site activation.
  • Identify critical-path activities, dependencies, and potential delays, implementing proactive mitigation plans.
  • Drive timely completion of start-up milestones while maintaining compliance and quality standards.
  1. Cross-Functional Project Management
  • Serve as the central point of coordination across internal departments, external sponsors, CROs, vendors, and site leadership.
  • Lead study start-up meetings, establish clear action items, assign owners, and ensure timely follow-through.
  • Create accountability across functional teams by clearly communicating responsibilities, deadlines, and expectations.
  • Proactively identify gaps in communication, handoffs, or ownership and resolve them before they impact timelines.
  • Escalate risks, delays, and unresolved issues with recommended solutions and recovery plans.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with clinical research teams while driving urgency and execution.
  • Ensure all stakeholders have visibility into study progress, priorities, risks, and upcoming milestones.
  1. Timeline, Milestone & Deliverable Management
  • Build and maintain detailed project plans and study start-up trackers.
  • Monitor milestone completion, deliverable status, and readiness across all active studies.
  • Establish realistic timelines and proactively manage competing priorities.
  • Identify bottlenecks and take immediate action to keep projects on schedule.
  • Provide accurate, timely, and actionable status reporting to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Maintain centralized documentation of project decisions, risks, action items, and dependencies.
  • Ensure timely escalation when deliverables are at risk, including clear corrective actions and ownership.
  1. Operational Readiness & Quality
  • Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure studies are operationally ready for activation, including staffing, training, supplies, systems, and required documentation.
  • Verify readiness of applicable clinical research platforms, including CTMS, eRegulatory, eSource, EDC, and other study-specific systems.
  • Ensure that required study start-up processes and documentation align with applicable GCP, regulatory requirements, sponsor expectations, and organizational SOPs.
  • Support effective handoffs from study start-up to ongoing clinical research operations.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve handoffs, standardize processes, and reduce study activation timelines.
  • Maintain a high standard of accuracy, completeness, and quality across all assigned projects.
  1. Stakeholder Communication & Reporting
  • Provide concise, structured updates on study status, milestones, risks, and next steps.
  • Communicate proactively rather than waiting for stakeholders to request updates.
  • Facilitate productive meetings with documented decisions, owners, and due dates.
  • Establish clear expectations with functional leaders and team members.
  • Professionally challenge missed deadlines, unclear ownership, and incomplete deliverables.
  • Serve as a trusted partner to client leadership by demonstrating ownership, reliability, and sound judgment.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, healthcare administration, clinical research, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in clinical research, preferably within clinical trial operations, site operations, or study start-up.
  • Demonstrated experience managing clinical research projects, study start-up activities, or site activation processes.
  • Strong understanding of the clinical trial lifecycle, particularly feasibility, regulatory requirements, IRB submissions, contracts, budgets, and site activation.
  • Experience coordinating multiple functional departments and managing interdependent deliverables.
  • Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), clinical research regulations, and standard operating procedures.
  • Proficiency with project management tools, trackers, Microsoft Excel, and collaborative platforms.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple studies or projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within a clinical research site, site network, SMO, CRO, or sponsor organization.
  • Direct experience managing multiple study activations concurrently.
  • Familiarity with CTMS, eRegulatory, eSource, and EDC platforms such as CRIO, Clinical Conductor, RealTime, Florence, or comparable systems.
  • Experience developing study start-up dashboards, standardized trackers, and operational performance reports.
  • PMP, ACRP, SOCRA, or other relevant professional certification.
  • Experience improving clinical research workflows and reducing study start-up cycle times.

Critical Success Attributes

We place significant emphasis on how this individual works, not just their technical qualifications.

Exceptionally Organized & Detail-Oriented

  • Maintains meticulous trackers, documentation, and action items.
  • Consistently follows through on commitments.
  • Manages multiple moving pieces without losing visibility into details.
  • Creates structure and clarity in complex or ambiguous environments.

Proactive & Self-Directed

  • Takes initiative without waiting for direction.
  • Anticipates issues and acts before they become problems.
  • Brings solutions and recommendations rather than simply identifying obstacles.
  • Demonstrates strong ownership of outcomes.

Accountable & Results-Driven

  • Treats deadlines as commitments.
  • Holds themselves and others accountable.
  • Takes responsibility for moving work forward, even when deliverables depend on other teams.
  • Remains focused on successful, on-time study activation.

Strong Cross-Functional Leader

  • Confidently coordinates teams and stakeholders without requiring direct reporting authority.
  • Communicates clearly, directly, and professionally.
  • Is comfortable following up, challenging delays, and escalating when necessary.
  • Builds collaborative relationships while maintaining urgency and accountability.

Thrives in a Fast-Paced Environment

  • Comfortably manages competing priorities and changing timelines.
  • Remains composed, focused, and organized under pressure.
  • Adapts quickly while maintaining a high standard of execution.
  • Demonstrates a strong sense of urgency and continuous improvement.

Key Performance Indicators / Measures of Success

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • On-Time Study Activation: Percentage of studies activated by the committed target date.
  • Milestone Adherence: Percentage of study start-up milestones completed on schedule.
  • Critical Deliverable Completion: Timely completion of required regulatory, contractual, operational, and system-readiness activities.
  • Risk Identification & Resolution: Proactive identification, escalation, and resolution of issues impacting study timelines.
  • Project Visibility & Accountability: Accuracy and completeness of study trackers, reporting, and action-item management.
  • Cross-Functional Effectiveness: Ability to drive timely decisions, remove bottlenecks, and maintain alignment across teams.
  • Continuous Improvement: Demonstrated improvements in start-up processes, coordination, and activation cycle times.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate will have established strong relationships with key stakeholders, gained a clear understanding of the client's study start-up processes, and assumed ownership of assigned study timelines and deliverables.

They will demonstrate the ability to independently lead cross-functional meetings, maintain accurate project tracking, proactively identify risks, and drive accountability across departments.

Most importantly, leadership should have confidence that every assigned study is being actively managed, potential delays are identified early, and nothing is falling through the cracks.

About UniTriTeam

UniTriTeam (UTT) partners with clinical research organizations to provide specialized operational, regulatory, technology, and project management support. Our team helps clients improve efficiency, strengthen execution, and scale clinical research operations through experienced professionals and practical, results-driven solutions.

We are committed to delivering exceptional service, operational excellence, and measurable results for our clients.

raw.description:
Company Overview


Shriners Children’s is an organization that respects, supports, and values each other. Named as the 2025 best mid-sized employer by Forbes, we are engaged in providing excellence in patient care, embracing multi-disciplinary education, and research with global impact. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. Our compassion, integrity, accountability, and resilience define us as leaders in pediatric specialty care for our children and their families.


With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.


CURRENT EMPLOYEES: Please log into Workday Click Here to apply internally through the "Jobs Hub"


Job Description


The Senior Accountant, Pediatric Orthotic & Prosthetic Services (POPS), is responsible for the accounting, financial reporting, compliance, and operational support activities for the Pediatric Orthotic and Prosthetic Services, LLCs of Shriners Children's. This position plays a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting regulatory compliance, preparing financial analyses and reporting, and ensuring the integrity of patient and financial data. The incumbent collaborates closely with the Corporate Director of O&P, location managers, Accounts Payable, and other stakeholders to support the financial operations of the POPS business.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Reconcile OPIE patient accounting data to Workday daily to ensure completeness and accuracy of financial activity. Investigate, resolve, and document discrepancies, including duplicate or missing interface transactions.
  • Monitor bank account and payments issued to ensure proper balance is maintained. Coordinate with appropriate departments regarding misdirected payments, returned deposits, or other banking issues.
  • Prepare bank reconciliation, general ledger account reconciliations, journal entries, and balance sheet account roll-forwards to ensure accurate recording of POPS activity.
  • Prepare month-end accounting entries related to POPS operations. Includes revenue recognition, activities at Central Fabrication (Cfab) locations, aged accounts receivable allowance calculations, and rent agreements between hospitals and POPS. Develop and maintain supporting schedules and documentation for all accounting entries and reconciliations in accordance with departmental standards.
  • Assist in Budget to Actual variance analysis, completing accounting adjustments and reclasses as needed.
  • Prepare detailed reports and supporting documentation for monthly Cfab production. Requires ability to properly format data from OPIE prior to providing information to Director of O&P, and Cfab managers.
  • Maintain communication with the POPS Accounts Payable supervisor to ensure compliance with established POPS guidelines are followed; and to resolve any issues.
  • Maintain communication and coordination with internal and external POPS managers and staff, as well as hospital/clinics staff as needed.
  • Assist in the preparation and review of assigned annual financial statement audit schedules and supporting documentation as requested.
  • Ability to run financial reports to provide support and guidance to the POPS team.
  • Respond to auditor inquiries and provide requested information related to assigned POPS accounting responsibilities.
  • Prepare regulatory filings and other external reporting requirements as assigned.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, organizational policies, Corporate O&P policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist in documenting and maintaining policies, procedures, workflows, and internal controls related to assigned responsibilities.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives designed to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and reporting capabilities.
  • Provide shared oversight and review of support staff work to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established procedures.
  • Collaborate effectively with Accounting, Treasury, and other stakeholders to support organizational objectives.

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 to 5 years of progressive accounting experience is
  • Experience preparing journal entries, account reconciliations, financial reports, and audit support documentation
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a hospital, healthcare, or not-for-profit environment

Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity.

raw.description:
Role and team:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Auditor to support planning and lead execution of global and/or regional operational and integrated audits spanning business operational controls, IT general controls and application controls. This remote position will be reporting to Director, Internal Audit Management. You’ll also help build the next version of Internal Audit by designing AI-enabled tools and automations that change how audits get done, not just using the tools others hand you.

We have a tight team environment where support, loyalty, and honest feedback are the currency. ServiceNow employees are expected to be self-starting, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Support planning and scoping of operational and integrated audits across business and IT operations. Complete assignments efficiently and timely.
  • Conduct walkthroughs, evaluate process design, and perform controls testing across both business processes and IT systems, consistently delivering quality audit work papers that support and substantiate audit observations.
  • Identify manual or repetitive steps in the audit lifecycle and build AI-enabled solutions to automate them, such as prompt workflows, AI agents, scripts, or data pipelines for evidence gathering, testing, and workpaper drafting.
  • Use data analytics and AI to test full populations when possible, identify control gaps, quantify risk exposure, and deliver data-driven insights to management.
  • Document and share what you build so the team can reuse it, and help shape Internal Audit’s AI playbook.
  • Assist in producing high-quality Internal Audit reports by clearly drafting audit issues and developing valid conclusions resulting in process and internal control improvements, while considering implementation requirements, cost, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Timely and effective communication with audit leads on audit status, escalations, issues, and reporting.
  • Perform action tracking follow-up with management for Audit Committee reporting purposes.
  • Participate in major business initiatives and proactively advise and assist the business on key risks, control environment, and change initiatives.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Internal Audit methodology, automation, and reporting, including ServiceNow IRM to scale audit coverage and quality.
  • Responsible for internal stakeholder engagement, including the development of working relationships with key stakeholders and proudly representing the Internal Audit function.

To be successful in this role, you have:

  • A passion for Internal Audit and strong desire to be part of a stellar IA team!
  • Minimum 4-year degree (or US equivalent) from an accredited university; degree in Management Information Systems, Finance and Accounting strongly preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ work experience, with 3 years at a public accounting firm (Big 4 or national consulting firm preferred), including experience in internal auditing, external auditing, SOX, operations and process improvement.
  • Demonstrated experience auditing both IT general controls and application controls, and business operational processes. Comfort moving fluidly between technology and business-process audits, including within the same integrated engagement.
  • Understanding of data governance and privacy compliance, and the ability to apply system architecture knowledge to the processes being reviewed.
  • Understanding of risks and controls in modern technology environments. Awareness of AI/GenAI governance and model risk considerations.
  • Builder track record: you’ve built something, such as a tool, automation, script, or AI workflow, that solved a real problem in your work. Be ready to walk us through it.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) beyond basic chat, such as building custom prompts, agents, or automated workflows.
  • Good understanding of business and operations, strong analytical and project management skills.
  • Proficiency in Excel and process mapping tools. Hands-on experience with data analytics tools such as Power BI. Experience with SAP preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills; ability to identify and conduct root cause analysis.
  • Excellent verbal, written, oral communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as a team member.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently, efficiently and effectively with minimal oversight.
  • Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform, including IRM modules, a strong plus
  • (Preferred) At least one of the following certifications: CISA, CISM, CIA, CPA
  • Prefer candidates with exposure to a high growth and/or rapidly changing technology enterprise.

About RAW Nutrition

RAW Nutrition and BUM Energy are led by entrepreneur Dr. Domenic Iacovone, six-time Mr. Olympia Champion Chris Bumstead, and renowned bodybuilding coach Matt Jansen. RAW Nutrition has been recognized as the #1 fastest-growing sports nutrition company by Inc. 5000 and recently named Brand of the Year by both GNC and The Vitamin Shoppe. 

Since its inception in 2019, every RAW Nutrition product has been made with premium, clean ingredients, free from unnecessary fillers and additives. RAW proudly carries the Informed-Sport certification, a mark of excellence that ensures our products are rigorously tested for prohibited substances and meet the highest standards of quality and safety. We are a team of athletes, creators, and innovators driven by authenticity and the relentless pursuit of being better. Whether you’re behind the barbell, behind the camera, or behind the keyboard, you’ll be joining a culture that values grit, growth, and excellence.

About the Role

We are looking for an Analyst to join our Demand Planning team and support our rapid growth in the CPG space. We need a dedicated team member to handle the day-to-day operational tasks so our leadership can focus on higher-level strategic work. In this position, you'll be responsible for data entry into Confido (our trade promotion and forecasting platform), entering forecast updates, managing trade promotions, ensuring new items flow correctly from NetSuite into Confido, verifying pricing accuracy, and manually uploading Excel files into our systems.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Enter and maintain all key inputs in Confido, forecast entries, pricing, new item setup, product and retailer mapping, and trade promotions (when needed)
  • Partner with Sales and Supply Planners, and other teams as needed, to translate FLINT submissions and other inputs into Confido
  • Monitor all Confido modules for data integrity, reconciling against NetSuite and other source documents and flagging discrepancies
  • Assist Finance with coding customer deductions and supporting dispute resolution
  • Prepare recurring reports and data pulls for the team
  • Keep documentation and process checklists current so the work is repeatable and scalable

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in CPG, sales operations, or supply chain
  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables and lookups
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with syndicated data (e.g., SPINS, Circana, NielsenIQ) and trade promotion management systems is a plus
  • NetSuite experience is a plus

Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation: The salary range is $55,000-$65,000; final salary offer based on experience and skillset.
  • Remote Schedule: With preference for candidates in the Central and Eastern time zones of the US.
  • Insurance & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus savings plans.
  • Retirement Savings: Plan for your future with a 401(k) savings plan featuring a company match.
  • Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need with a flex PTO plan, sick time, and paid holidays.
  • Extra Perks: Monthly stipend to spend on our products and gear and access to the RAW Athletic Clubs in Port St. Lucie and Stuart, FL (for our hybrid employees.)

Posting Description The Assistant Vice President – Commercial General Liability Claims is responsible for providing claims advocacy and account management services to clients involving moderate, complex and catastrophic claims. The Assistant Vice President is the contact/liaison/advocate between the client, carrier and NFP. The primary purpose is to assure clients receive exceptional service, maximization of policy coverage, in-depth advice and claims advocacy in a timely and effective manner. This will be accomplished by adhering to claims procedures, implementation of effective and consistent claims service programs and direct participation in and oversight of collaborative claims resolution strategies. This position requires significant commercial general liability claims experience, expertise in written and verbal communications, a high level of organization and the ability to work in an independent setting. Principal Roles and Responsibilities Senior technical specialist role involving complex and catastrophic claims, heavy litigation, in numerous State and Federal jurisdictions. Serve as a trusted advocate for clients and key partners by delivering strategic guidance and expert oversight in the management of general liability claims. Engage collaboratively with clients, their representatives, insurers, technical experts, consultants, producers, and account managers to effectively advocate for client interests and ensure alignment across all partners. Take ownership of resolving client claim issues in a timely manner, ensuring clear and proactive communication of outcomes to all relevant partners. Prompt notification to Claims Leaders, Sale and Service team, and others of large reserve changes in excess of $100,000. Maintain thorough and timely documentation within the EPIC claim file system, including detailed updates on claim activity, client and carrier interactions, and supporting documentation. Ensure all correspondence and materials are accurately filed using established naming conventions to preserve a comprehensive and auditable claim history. Conduct thorough coverage analysis and research to address claim-related issues and collaborate closely with clients and their representatives to develop and present well-reasoned coverage rebuttals when appropriate (on occasion may assist other lines of business, including but not limited to Commercial Transportation/Automobile, Private Client Group, Personal Risk Teams, etc.). Attend (virtually or in-person) client meetings, including claim reviews, pre-renewals, renewal, etc. Support the General Liability Claim Leader and Sales Team in resolving client claim issues by providing responsive assistance and collaborative problem-solving to ensure timely and effective outcomes. Provide support to Claim Leadership on a variety of initiatives, including the development and refinement of procedures, enhancement of claim service programs, and execution of ad-hoc projects. Occasionally author white papers and/or give presentations on topics clients are facings. Education, Experience and Skills Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree required. Additional insurance certifications and/or legal background are a plus. Experience: A minimum of 15 years of experience in the commercial general liability claims industry is required. Candidates must have held a Senior Claims Analyst role or higher. Additional experience in commercial insurance sales, marketing, or other lines of business is considered a strong asset. Skills: Proficiency with general liability insurance products, contractual risk transfer, claims handling and management, and processes. Strong solid understanding of transportation/automobile liability, management liability (E&O, D&O, Cyber, Crime), property and workers compensation coverages a plus. Proven background of working effectively with clients and partners in Claims Analyst, Service or Management capacity involving complex coverage, litigation, large and catastrophic general liability claims in jurisdictions across the United States. High level of organizational skills with proven successful experience in managing multiple tasks and internal /external clients concurrently in a claims setting. Demonstrated expertise in written and verbal communications. Customer Service – Manages difficult or emotional client situations; Responds promptly to client needs. Proficiency with using broker based and carrier claims software applications. Knowledge of the EPIC system is a plus. Proficiency with all Microsoft Suite of products including excel, outlook, word and power point. Proficiency in performing web-based meetings and with performing in person audio / visual presentations to small and large size groups. Proficiency in coordinating and performing technical claims discussions with internal and external clients. Proficiency in coordinating claims audits and reviews. Collaboration - Balances team and individual responsibilities Ethics - Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values. Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values. Judgment - Exhibits sound and accurate judgment; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process. Motivation - Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles. Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Sets goals and objectives; Can assist with organization and schedules of other people and their tasks. What We Offer: We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $100,000 – $120,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives. NFP and You... Better Together! Location

raw.description:
JOB TITLE: Junior Staff Accountant

POSITION CLASSIFICATION: Associate

SALARY BAND: B

REPORTS TO: Director, Finance & Accounting

LOCATION: Remote

About American Rivers

American Rivers is a national conservation organization working to make every river clean and healthy for people and wildlife. We combine evidence-based solutions with enduring partnerships to safeguard the 4.4 million miles of rivers and streams that are essential to our nation’s clean drinking water, extraordinary wildlife, and the strength of our communities. For more than 50 years, our staff, supporters, and partners have been driven by a common belief: Life Depends on Rivers.

The beauty of rivers is that they connect all people and communities – including within our organization. The life experiences, knowledge, innovation, and talent that different people bring to our work provides perspectives, experiences, and competencies which are critical to our effectiveness in protecting wild rivers, restoring damaged rivers, and conserving clean water for people and nature.

JOB SUMMARY

The Junior Staff Accountant provides support to the Finance and Accounting team to ensure that American Rivers’ accounting functions are performed in accordance with GAAP and organizational guidelines and that transactions are recorded in a timely manner.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Accounts Payable (A/P): (25%)
    • Process vendor invoices accurately and promptly, ensuring proper approvals and coding.
    • Verify that all expenditures are properly authorized and supported with appropriate documentation.
    • Maintain detailed documentation and audit trails for all federal award transactions.
    • Prepare and process electronic payments, ACH transfers, and check disbursements.
    • Vendor File Maintenance:
      • Verify and collect required documentation from all vendors, including W-9 forms, executed contracts, and proof of insurance where applicable.
      • Review vendor information for accuracy before activation and regularly update vendor data (e.g., addresses, tax IDs, banking details).
      • Ensure vendor setup complies with internal control policies, procurement standards, and federal grant regulations under OMB Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200).
  • Accounts Receivable (A/R): (25%)
    • Record and reconcile incoming payments, including grant reimbursements, donor contributions, and other receivables.
    • Prepare and submit invoices to funding agencies and clients in accordance with contract and grant requirements.
    • Track outstanding receivables and follow up on delayed payments or discrepancies.
    • Process and record all federal award drawdowns and reimbursements.
  • General Ledger and Reconciliations (25%)
    • Prepare journal entries, adjusting entries, and closing entries as needed.
    • Support month-end and year-end closing processes.
    • Perform regular bank reconciliations and ensure all transactions are accurately reflected in accounting records.
    • Reconcile credit card and balance sheet general ledger accounts monthly.
    • Identify, investigate, and correct discrepancies promptly.
  • Compliance (25%)
    • 1099 Reporting:
      • Prepare and issue annual Form 1099-NEC/MISC to vendors in compliance with IRS regulations.
      • Maintain accurate vendor records to ensure timely and accurate year-end reporting.
    • Audit and Reporting Support:
      • Provide accurate schedules and reconciliations to auditors and management as requested.
      • Assist with annual audits, single audits (if applicable), and other financial reviews.
      • Support the Finance Department in preparing accurate schedules, reports, and grant-related reconciliations.
    • Regulatory and Standards Compliance:
      • Ensure all accounting activities and records comply with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
      • Adhere to all applicable rules and regulations set forth by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS), U.S. Department of Labor (DOL), Office of Management and Budget (OMB), and other relevant state and federal authorities.
  • Perform other duties and special projects in support of the department as needed.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field desired. Internship or relevant coursework experience is a plus.
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and proactively in a remote environment.
  • Well organized with high attention to detail.
  • Ability to take initiative and follow through on assignments with minimal direction.
  • Team player with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with geographically dispersed colleagues.
  • Ability to multi-task and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including phone, email, and video conferencing.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and Adobe software.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home workspace.
  • Personal commitment to American Rivers’ mission.

Candidates who are unsure if they meet all minimum qualifications or who have transferrable skills and experience beyond the conservation sector are encouraged to apply.

LOCATION

Remote within AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MT, NC, NM, NY, NV, OH, OR, PA, SC, TX, VA, WA, WI, NY and WY.

COMPENSATION

American Rivers offers marketable compensation that reflects the qualifications and experience of the selected candidate. The salary range for this position is $52,600-$64,200, annually, depending on experience and qualifications. Pay rates are offered in compliance with all applicable state wage and hour regulations. We provide a comprehensive Total Rewards package to our full-time, regular employees, including:

  • Health and Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, long-term and short-term disability, and life insurance.
  • Financial Security: After one year of service, American Rivers begins contributing a 3% employer contribution. There is no vesting schedule for employer contributions as employees are 100% vested upon participation.
  • Time Off: Four weeks of paid leave, eleven paid holidays, three floating holidays, and sick leave.

At American Rivers, we are committed to supporting our employee’s well-being, professional growth, and financial security, ensuring they can thrive both at work and in life.

COMMUNITY AND OPPORTUNITY

  • At American Rivers, our core values drive everything we do – we Lead with Collaboration and Trust, Infuse Equity and Justice, Deliver Results, and Ensure Staff and Volunteers Thrive. We are committed to fostering a workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to make a difference.
  • Our culture prioritizes work-life thriving through Focus Fridays (no internal meetings), professional development opportunities, a home office stipend and our comprehensive leave policies, including sabbatical leave (every seven years) and paid parental leave (six weeks w/ one year of service).
  • We also ensure leadership stays connected to staff needs through an internal advisory group, fostering open communication and continuous improvement.
  • At American Rivers, our people are our strength, and we are dedicated to building a thriving, inclusive workplace where everyone can grow and contribute to our mission.

American Rivers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities upon request. To request this document in an alternate format or to request reasonable accommodation, please contact the Human Resources department at 202-243-7040 or . Please note that one week’s advance notice is preferred.

Applicant must be legally allowed to work as an employee in the United States.American Rivers is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Candidates of all personal and professional backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Salary: $52,600-$64,200

Duties may include the following responsibilities or functions required to support the claims unit. Accurate processing of claims edits, determining primacy for the Coordination of Benefits (COB), adjusting previously paid claims and initiating procedures to recover funds on overpaid claims. Accountable for complying with all laws and regulations that are associated with duties and responsibilities.

NATURE AND SCOPE

Various external entities including, but not limited to, Providers, Members, Lawyers, Groups, Commissioner of Insurance, other insurance companies, and other Plans.
QUALIFICATIONS

Education
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
Work Experience
  • 6 months of experience in medical claims or health insurance-related customer service or the successful completion of BCBSLA adjustment or COB training

  • Working knowledge of relevant PC software.

ACCOUNTABILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Requesting of medical records may be required.
  • Communicates, both orally and in writing, with internal and external contacts in order to provide necessary and accurate information for the establishment of sound claim records. This may include, but is not limited to, the coordination of benefits (COB), medical record requests, etc.

Communicates to appropriate department(s) when Medicare has determined primacy incorrectly and ensures a letter is generated to notify Medicare. Failure to report discrepancy could result in a daily fine up to $1,000.00.

raw.description:
About RAB2B

RAB2B is a global B2B marketing agency that partners with ambitious brands to drive measurable growth. We combine strategic thinking, media excellence, and operational rigor to deliver integrated solutions across markets. Our culture is built on accountability, clarity, and performance, empowering our teams to lead with ownership while collaborating across disciplines.

About the role

The Campaign Manager (Performance Analyst) is responsible for the implementation, monitoring, and optimization of digital campaigns across platforms, ensuring accuracy in execution, data integrity, and performance delivery.

As part of the performance hub, this role supports campaign delivery across multiple accounts, executing against defined strategies and adhering to established standards, processes, and playbooks.

The Campaign Manager focuses on execution excellence, working under the guidance of the Supervisor of Performance, and plays a critical role in ensuring campaigns are launched, managed, and optimized with precision.

What you'll do

Campaign Implementation

  • Execute digital campaigns across platforms including:
    • Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube)
    • Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn)
    • Programmatic platforms (Trade Desk, StackAdapt, DV360, or equivalent)
  • Build campaigns in alignment with approved plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Ensure proper setup of:
    • Campaign structures
    • Naming conventions
    • UTMs and tracking parameters

Monitoring & Optimization

  • Monitor campaign performance daily to ensure delivery against KPIs and investment targets.
  • Optimize campaigns based on performance metrics such as CPA, CTR, CVR, ROAS, and delivery pacing.
  • Adjust bids, budgets, audiences, and creatives to improve performance.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and performance issues, and escalate when necessary.

Budget & Pacing Control

  • Track campaign pacing and ensure alignment with planned investment.
  • Flag under-delivery, overspend, or performance risks proactively.
  • Support reconciliation between planned and executed budgets.

Tracking & Execution Support

  • Support the implementation of tracking, including pixels, tags, and conversion events, following defined specifications.
  • Validate basic tracking functionality and ensure campaigns are properly instrumented.
  • Escalate complex tracking or data discrepancies to the Supervisor.

Quality Assurance (QA)

  • Execute QA processes based on established playbooks and standards.
  • Verify campaign setup, assets, links, and configurations prior to launch.
  • Ensure campaigns meet internal and client quality requirements before and after deployment.

Reporting & Insights

  • Build and maintain campaign performance reports and dashboards.
  • Analyze campaign data and provide insights on performance trends.
  • Support post-campaign reporting and documentation of learnings.
  • Prepare inputs for monthly reporting and billing processes.

Operational Support

  • Support billing and reconciliation processes, including campaign closures and invoicing inputs.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of campaign setups, changes, and performance.
  • Ensure compliance with internal processes, policies, and operational standards.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with Planners and Associate Directors to align execution with strategy.
  • Collaborate with creative, analytics, and data teams to ensure proper implementation.

Follow guidance from the Supervisor on optimization, technical setup, and troubleshooting.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in digital campaign management, performance marketing, or media buying.
  • Hands-on experience executing campaigns across multiple digital platforms.

Technical Expertise (Mandatory)

  • Strong experience with:
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads Manager
    • TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads or similar platforms
    • Programmatic platforms such as Trade Desk, StackAdapt, DV360, or equivalent ¿
  • Solid understanding of:
    • Campaign structure and optimization techniques
    • Audience targeting and segmentation
    • Conversion tracking (pixels, UTMs, tagging)
    • Digital media KPIs and performance metrics

Technical Skills

  • Intermediate to advanced Excel skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and identify performance trends.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards.

Find your future at Revvity

The Role

We’re looking for a Principal to lead our most important engagements and help shape the future of the firm. This is a senior client-facing role with broad responsibility across business development, client delivery, and intellectual leadership. Principals at Realize 2050 operate as player-coaches—they lead high-stakes consulting engagements while also mentoring teams, codifying internal IP, and opening new markets.

If you’re a strategic thinker with commercial instincts, comfortable in both regulated boardrooms and whiteboard sessions with founders, this role offers the opportunity to shape how utilities and infrastructure evolve over the coming decade.

What You’ll Do

Strategy & Delivery Leadership

  • Lead multi-workstream client engagements across utilities, startups, and government

  • Own senior relationships with utility execs, public sector leaders, and venture teams

  • Frame ambiguous problems and design analytically rigorous, action-oriented solutions

  • Translate technical complexity (e.g., interconnection, grid planning, DER valuation) into compelling strategy and commercial insight

  • Build and test commercialization pathways for new technologies and business models

  • Serve as a mentor and model for Engagement Managers and Associates

Business Development

  • Lead proposal development and pitch strategy for six- and seven-figure projects

  • Identify white space opportunities and proactively shape new client offerings

  • Cultivate new client relationships and deepen existing partnerships

  • Represent Realize 2050 in key industry conversations—at conferences, in workshops, and during critical engagements

Thought Leadership & Venture Design

  • Develop internal frameworks, tools, and templates that codify Realize 2050’s unique approach

  • Author public-facing insights, white papers, and concept notes that elevate our voice in the market

  • Identify and shape potential venture spinouts from client engagements

  • Serve as an internal anchor for new practices in AI, gridtech, or infrastructure finance

You Might Be a Fit If You Have

  • 10+ years of experience across strategy consulting, innovation, utilities, startup leadership, or infrastructure

  • Deep exposure to utility, gridtech, or climate innovation ecosystems

  • Track record leading complex, cross-functional projects with senior stakeholders

  • Exceptional communication and synthesis skills, across memos, presentations, and live facilitation

  • Financial fluency in energy economics, including PPA structures, resilience valuation, and capital planning

  • Experience with product strategy, new venture design, or market-making in regulated industries

  • Entrepreneurial judgment and a strong bias toward action

Bonus Points For

  • Experience working inside or alongside investor-owned utilities, ISO/RTOs, or regulatory agencies

  • A track record of launching or scaling early-stage ventures

  • Familiarity with AI/ML technologies, grid planning tools, or infrastructure modeling

  • Experience navigating public-private partnerships, grant programs, or regulatory proceedings

We are looking for an experienced Revenue Manager to join our Finance team and take ownership of revenue accounting, recognition, forecasting and reporting across the business.


This hands-on role requires demonstrated experience with NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) and will work closely with Finance, Sales, Professional Services and other operational teams to ensure accurate revenue reporting and strong financial controls.

What you’ll do


  • Own the end-to-end revenue recognition and accounting process, ensuring accurate and timely recognition in accordance with IFRS 15 and company policies.
  • Review customer contracts and commercial arrangements to determine the appropriate accounting and revenue recognition treatment.
  • Manage revenue schedules across software licenses, maintenance and support, subscription, SaaS, professional services and other customer arrangements.
  • Lead monthly, quarterly and year-end revenue close activities, including revenue recognition journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, deferred/unbilled revenue and work in progress (WIP).
  • Own the revenue recognition process in NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), including revenue arrangements, revenue elements, recognition rules, revenue plans and revenue recognition journal entries.
  • Investigate and resolve NetSuite ARM issues, including missing or incorrect revenue arrangements, recognition dates, revenue plans and postings; reconcile ARM balances and schedules to the general ledger.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate revenue forecasts, working closely with Sales, Professional Services and Finance.
  • Monitor actual revenue against forecast and provide clear analysis of variances, trends and risks.
  • Partner with commercial teams on complex contracts, pricing structures, renewals and contract modifications to assess their revenue impact.
  • Support order-to-cash processes, including alignment between contracts, billing and revenue recognition.
  • Maintain appropriate controls and documentation around revenue accounting and support internal and external audit requirements.
  • Produce revenue reporting, analysis and KPIs for Finance and senior management.
  • Identify opportunities to improve revenue processes, reporting, controls and automation, particularly through better use of NetSuite ARM, saved searches and system functionality.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting and broader financial planning activities relating to revenue.

What you bring


  • At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for revenue accounting and recognition.
  • Strong technical knowledge and practical application of IFRS 15 revenue recognition requirements; familiarity with ASC 606 is an advantage.
  • Experience working with software, SaaS, technology or recurring-revenue business models including software licenses, maintenance and professional services.
  • Experience reviewing customer contracts and translating commercial terms into accounting treatment.
  • Strong understanding of deferred revenue, accrued/unbilled revenue, contract modifications and revenue forecasting.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience developing and using NetSuite saved searches, financial reports and reconciliations.
  • Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Comfortable partnering with Sales and operational stakeholders while maintaining appropriate financial controls.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple entities, currencies and international teams.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field.
  • Professional accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent would be an advantage.

MUST HAVE: Demonstrable, hands-on experience with NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), including revenue arrangements, revenue elements, revenue plans, revenue recognition journal entries and troubleshooting. General NetSuite ERP experience without practical ARM experience is not sufficient.
